local settings = require "core.settings"

local EMPTY = { allowed = false }

---@type table?
local data

local admin = {}

---@param payload table?
local function publish(payload)
    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({ action = "admin_data", data = payload or EMPTY }))
end

RegisterNetEvent("rhd_appearance:admin:data", function(payload)
    if source == '' then return end

    data = payload

    settings.reset()
    publish(data)
end)

function admin.reset()
    if not data then return end

    data = nil

    publish(nil)
end

local ACTIONS = {
    admin_save_entry = "rhd_appearance:admin:blacklist:save",
    admin_delete_entry = "rhd_appearance:admin:blacklist:delete",
    admin_sync_blacklist = "rhd_appearance:admin:blacklist:sync",
    admin_register_half_ped = "rhd_appearance:admin:halfped:register",
    admin_remove_half_ped = "rhd_appearance:admin:halfped:remove",
    admin_grant_half_ped = "rhd_appearance:admin:halfped:grant",
    admin_revoke_half_ped = "rhd_appearance:admin:halfped:revoke",
    admin_save_ped_rule = "rhd_appearance:admin:peds:save",
    admin_delete_ped_rule = "rhd_appearance:admin:peds:delete",
    admin_sync_peds = "rhd_appearance:admin:peds:sync",
    admin_save_ped_catalogue = "rhd_appearance:admin:catalogue:save"
}

for callback, target in pairs(ACTIONS) do
    RegisterNUICallback(callback, function(payload, cb)
        local result = lib.callback.await(target, false, payload)

        if not result then
            lib.notify({ description = locale("notify.adminFailed"), type = "error" })
        end

        cb(result)
    end)
end

return admin


########## FILE: \features\barber.lua
local ped = require "core.ped"
local settings = require "core.settings"
local editor = require "core.editor"
local clothing = require "features.clothing"
local menus = require "config.menu"

local HAT = "hat"
local RELAY_INTERVAL = 100
local SUBMIT_TIMEOUT = 20000

---@class BarberMenuOptions
---@field target number?
---@field relay boolean?
---@field appearance table?
---@field hairBlacklist HairBlacklist?
---@field hatWorn boolean?
---@field title string?
---@field subtitle string?
---@field prices table<string, number>?
---@field bundles table<string, string>?
---@field action 'pay'|'bill'|'view'?
---@field methods string[]?
---@field onChange fun(values: table)?
---@field onHat fun(hidden: boolean)?
---@field onSubmit fun(values: table<string, number>, method: string?)?
---@field onCancel fun()?

---@class BarberSession
---@field target number
---@field relay boolean
---@field viewer boolean
---@field original PedAppearance
---@field options BarberMenuOptions
---@field blacklist HairBlacklist?
---@field hat { hidden: boolean, available: boolean }
---@field sent table<string, table>?
---@field queued table?
---@field pending fun(result: table)?
---@field silent boolean?

---@type BarberSession?
local session

local barber = {}

---@param base PedAppearance
---@param fields table?
---@return PedAppearance
local function withFields(base, fields)
    if type(fields) ~= "table" then return base end

    local merged = table.clone(base)

    if type(fields.hair) == "table" then merged.hair = fields.hair end

    if type(fields.headOverlays) == "table" then
        local overlays = table.clone(base.headOverlays)

        for name, overlay in pairs(fields.headOverlays) do
            overlays[name] = overlay
        end

        merged.headOverlays = overlays
    end

    if type(fields.eyeColor) == "number" then merged.eyeColor = fields.eyeColor end

    return merged
end

---@param entity number
---@param fields table
local function applyFields(entity, fields)
    if type(fields.headOverlays) == "table" then ped.setHeadOverlays(entity, fields.headOverlays) end
    if type(fields.eyeColor) == "number" then ped.setEyeColor(entity, fields.eyeColor) end
    if type(fields.hair) == "table" then ped.setHair(entity, fields.hair) end
end

---@param a table?
---@param b table?
---@return boolean
local function sameOverlay(a, b)
    return a ~= nil and b ~= nil
        and a.style == b.style
        and a.opacity == b.opacity
        and a.color == b.color
        and a.secondColor == b.secondColor
end

---@param current BarberSession
---@param fields table
local function queue(current, fields)
    local pending = current.queued or {}

    if fields.hair then pending.hair = fields.hair end
    if fields.eyeColor then pending.eyeColor = fields.eyeColor end

    if fields.headOverlays then
        pending.headOverlays = pending.headOverlays or {}

        for name, overlay in pairs(fields.headOverlays) do
            pending.headOverlays[name] = overlay
        end
    end

    current.queued = pending
end

---@param current BarberSession
local function flush(current)
    local values = current.queued

    if not values then return end

    current.queued = nil

    if current.options.onChange then
        pcall(current.options.onChange, values)
    end
end

---@param current BarberSession
---@param result PedAppearance|boolean?
local function finish(current, result)
    if session == current then session = nil end

    local pending = current.pending

    if pending then
        current.pending = nil
        pending({ success = false })
    end

    if result == true then return end

    if not current.relay and not current.viewer then
        applyFields(cache.ped, current.original)
    end

    if not current.silent and current.options.onCancel then
        pcall(current.options.onCancel)
    end
end

function barber.pushHat()
    local current = session

    if not current or not current.relay then return end

    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({
        action = "clothing_status",
        data = { [HAT] = { hidden = current.hat.hidden, swap = false, available = current.hat.available } }
    }))
end

---@return boolean
function barber.active()
    return session ~= nil
end

---@return boolean
function barber.busy()
    return session ~= nil and session.pending ~= nil
end

---@param options BarberMenuOptions
---@return boolean
function barber.open(options)
    if session or editor.active() or type(options) ~= "table" then return false end

    local viewer = options.action == "view"
    local target = not viewer and options.target or cache.ped
    local relay = not viewer and options.relay == true and target ~= cache.ped

    if not DoesEntityExist(target) then return false end
    if relay and type(options.appearance) ~= "table" then return false end

    ---@type PedAppearance
    local original

    if relay then
        original = options.appearance --[[@as PedAppearance]]
    else
        original = withFields(ped.get(cache.ped), options.appearance)

        if options.appearance then
            applyFields(cache.ped, original)
        end
    end

    local menu = lib.table.deepclone(menus.default)

    menu.headOverlays = true
    menu.barber = {
        title = options.title or "",
        subtitle = options.subtitle or "",
        prices = options.prices or {},
        bundles = options.bundles or {},
        action = (options.action == "bill" or viewer) and options.action or "pay",
        methods = options.methods or {}
    }

    ---@type BarberSession
    local current = {
        target = target,
        relay = relay,
        viewer = viewer,
        original = original,
        options = options,
        blacklist = relay and options.hairBlacklist or nil,
        hat = { hidden = false, available = options.hatWorn == true },
        sent = relay and table.clone(original.headOverlays or {}) or nil
    }

    session = current

    CreateThread(function()
        local opened = editor.open(menu, function(result)
            finish(current, result)
        end, { target = target, original = original })

        if not opened then
            if session == current then session = nil end

            if current.options.onCancel then pcall(current.options.onCancel) end

            return
        end

        if not relay then return end

        barber.pushHat()

        while session == current do
            Wait(RELAY_INTERVAL)

            if session == current then flush(current) end
        end
    end)

    return true
end

---@param notify boolean?
function barber.close(notify)
    local current = session

    if not current then return end

    current.silent = notify ~= true

    editor.close()
end

---@return table?
function barber.settings()
    local current = session

    if not current then return end

    local all = settings.all(current.target)

    if current.relay then
        all.hair = settings.hair(current.target, current.original.hair and current.original.hair.style, current.blacklist)
    end

    return all
end

---@param hair PedHair
---@return table
function barber.changeHair(hair)
    local current = session

    if not current or current.viewer or type(hair) ~= "table" then return settings.hair(cache.ped) end

    if current.relay then
        queue(current, { hair = hair })

        return settings.hair(current.target, hair.style, current.blacklist)
    end

    ped.setHair(cache.ped, hair)

    return settings.hair(cache.ped)
end

---@param overlays PedHeadOverlays
function barber.changeOverlays(overlays)
    local current = session

    if not current or current.viewer or type(overlays) ~= "table" then return end

    if not current.relay then
        ped.setHeadOverlays(cache.ped, overlays)

        return
    end

    local changed, any = {}, false

    for name, overlay in pairs(overlays) do
        if type(overlay) == "table" and not sameOverlay(current.sent[name], overlay) then
            changed[name] = overlay
            current.sent[name] = overlay
            any = true
        end
    end

    if any then queue(current, { headOverlays = changed }) end
end

---@param value number
---@return number
function barber.changeEyeColor(value)
    local current = session

    if not current or current.viewer or type(value) ~= "number" then return ped.getEyeColor(cache.ped) end

    if current.relay then
        queue(current, { eyeColor = value })

        return value
    end

    ped.setEyeColor(cache.ped, value)

    return ped.getEyeColor(cache.ped)
end

---@param items string[]
---@return boolean
function barber.toggleHat(items)
    local current = session

    if not current or current.viewer or type(items) ~= "table" or #items ~= 1 or items[1] ~= HAT then return false end

    if not current.relay then
        return clothing.toggleGroup({ HAT })
    end

    if not current.hat.available then return false end

    current.hat.hidden = not current.hat.hidden

    if current.options.onHat then
        pcall(current.options.onHat, current.hat.hidden)
    end

    barber.pushHat()

    return true
end

---@param data { values: table<string, number>?, method: string? }?
---@param cb fun(result: table)
function barber.submit(data, cb)
    local current = session

    if not current or current.pending or not current.options.onSubmit then
        return cb({ success = false })
    end

    if current.relay then flush(current) end

    current.pending = cb

    local values = type(data) == "table" and type(data.values) == "table" and data.values or {}
    local method = type(data) == "table" and type(data.method) == "string" and data.method or nil

    if not pcall(current.options.onSubmit, values, method) then
        current.pending = nil

        return cb({ success = false, message = locale("barber.failed") })
    end

    SetTimeout(SUBMIT_TIMEOUT, function()
        if current.pending ~= cb then return end

        current.pending = nil
        cb({ success = false, message = locale("barber.timeout") })
    end)
end

---@param result { success: boolean, message: string? }?
---@return boolean
function barber.resolve(result)
    local current = session

    if not current or not current.pending then return false end

    local cb = current.pending --[[@as fun(result: table)]]
    local success = type(result) == "table" and result.success == true

    current.pending = nil
    cb({ success = success, message = type(result) == "table" and result.message or nil })

    if success then
        CreateThread(function()
            if session == current then editor.close(true) end
        end)
    end

    return true
end

---@return { appearance: PedAppearance, hairBlacklist: HairBlacklist, hatWorn: boolean }
function barber.snapshot()
    local hat = clothing.status()[HAT]

    return {
        appearance = ped.get(cache.ped),
        hairBlacklist = settings.hairBlacklist(cache.ped),
        hatWorn = hat ~= nil and hat.available == true
    }
end

---@param fields table
---@return boolean
function barber.apply(fields)
    if type(fields) ~= "table" then return false end

    applyFields(cache.ped, fields)

    if session and session.viewer then
        SendNuiMessage(json.encode({
            action = "barber_sync",
            data = {
                hair = ped.getHair(cache.ped),
                headOverlays = ped.getHeadOverlays(cache.ped),
                eyeColor = ped.getEyeColor(cache.ped),
                hairSettings = settings.hair(cache.ped)
            }
        }))
    end

    return true
end

---@param hidden boolean
---@return boolean
function barber.setHat(hidden)
    if clothing.hidden(HAT) == (hidden == true) then return true end

    return clothing.toggleGroup({ HAT })
end

return barber


########## FILE: \features\character.lua
local config = require "config.menu"
local ped = require "core.ped"
local editor = require "core.editor"
local shops = require "features.shops"

local character = {}

---@param gender string
local function applyInitialClothes(gender)
    local preset = config.newCharacter.clothes[gender]

    if not preset then return end

    local entity = preset.model and ped.setModel(preset.model) or cache.ped

    ped.setComponents(entity, preset.components or {})
    ped.setProps(entity, preset.props or {})

    if preset.hair then
        ped.setHair(entity, preset.hair)
    end
end

---@return boolean isolated
local function isolate()
    if not config.newCharacter.routingBucket then return false end

    return lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:character:isolate", false) == true
end

---@param isolated boolean
local function restore(isolated)
    if isolated then
        lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:character:restore", false)
    end
end

---@return table
local function createMenu()
    local menu = table.clone(config.default)

    for key, value in pairs(config.newCharacter.menu) do
        menu[key] = value
    end

    return menu
end

local function waitForSpot()
    local duration = config.newCharacter.countdown

    if not duration or duration <= 0 then return end

    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({
        action = "character_countdown",
        data = { duration = duration }
    }))

    Wait(duration)

    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({
        action = "character_countdown_hide",
        data = {}
    }))
end

---@param gender string?
---@param onSubmit fun()?
---@param onCancel fun()?
function character.create(gender, onSubmit, onCancel)
    if editor.active() then return end

    gender = gender or Framework.GetGender()

    waitForSpot()

    applyInitialClothes(gender)
    shops.clear()

    local isolated = isolate()

    editor.open(createMenu(), function(appearance)
        restore(isolated)

        if appearance then
            if onSubmit then onSubmit() end
        elseif onCancel then
            onCancel()
        end

        return true
    end)
end

return character


########## FILE: \features\clothing.lua
local config = require "data.clothing"
local halfped = require "features.halfped"
local TOGGLE_INTERVAL = require("config.clothing").interval

local DECAL_COMPONENT = 10

---@class ClothingAnim
---@field dict string
---@field clip string
---@field flag number
---@field duration number

local GENDER_MODELS = {
    [`mp_m_freemode_01`] = "male",
    [`mp_f_freemode_01`] = "female"
}

local RESET_ANIM = {
    dict = "clothingtie",
    clip = "try_tie_negative_a",
    flag = 51,
    duration = 1200
}

---@type table<number|string, table>
local stored = {}

---@type table<string, number>
local lastVariation = {}

---@type table<string, number>
local lastToggle = {}

local cooldown = false
local railOpen = false

local clothing = {}

---@param key string
---@return boolean
local function throttled(key)
    local now = GetGameTimer()

    if lastToggle[key] and now - lastToggle[key] < TOGGLE_INTERVAL then return true end

    lastToggle[key] = now

    return false
end

---@param propId number
---@return string
local function propKey(propId)
    return "prop_" .. propId
end

---@param itemName string
---@return (number|string)[]
local function slotKeys(itemName)
    local item = config[itemName]
    local keys = {}

    if not item then return keys end

    local components = item.components

    if components then
        if components.id then
            keys[#keys + 1] = components.id
        else
            for i = 1, #components do
                keys[#keys + 1] = components[i].componentId
            end
        end
    end

    if item.props then
        keys[#keys + 1] = propKey(item.props.id)
    end

    return keys
end

---@param itemName string
---@return boolean
local function isSwap(itemName)
    local item = config[itemName]

    if not item then return false end

    return (item.components and item.components.variation ~= nil)
        or (item.props and item.props.variation ~= nil)
end

---@param componentId number
---@param drawable number
---@param texture number?
local function setComponent(componentId, drawable, texture)
    SetPedComponentVariation(cache.ped, componentId, drawable, texture or 0, 0)
end

---@param propId number
---@param index number
---@param texture number?
local function setProp(propId, index, texture)
    if index == -1 then
        ClearPedProp(cache.ped, propId)
    else
        SetPedPropIndex(cache.ped, propId, index, texture or 0, true)
    end
end

---@param componentId number
---@return table
local function componentState(componentId)
    return {
        id = componentId,
        drawable = GetPedDrawableVariation(cache.ped, componentId),
        texture = GetPedTextureVariation(cache.ped, componentId),
        type = "component"
    }
end

---@param propId number
---@return table
local function propState(propId)
    return {
        id = propId,
        prop = GetPedPropIndex(cache.ped, propId),
        texture = GetPedPropTextureIndex(cache.ped, propId),
        type = "prop"
    }
end

---@return "male"|"female"|"custom"
function clothing.gender()
    return GENDER_MODELS[GetEntityModel(cache.ped)] or "custom"
end

---@param itemName string
---@return boolean
function clothing.hidden(itemName)
    if isSwap(itemName) then return false end

    local keys = slotKeys(itemName)

    return #keys > 0 and stored[keys[1]] ~= nil
end

---@param itemName string
---@param gender string
---@return boolean
local function atDefault(itemName, gender)
    local item = config[itemName]
    local components = item.components

    if components then
        local slot = components.id and components or components[1]
        local target = components.id and slot.drawable or slot.drawableId
        local off = target and (target[gender] or target.custom or 0) or 0

        return componentState(components.id or slot.componentId).drawable == off
    end

    if item.props then
        local target = item.props.drawable
        local off = target and (target[gender] or target.custom or -1) or -1

        return propState(item.props.id).prop == off
    end

    return false
end

---@param components table
---@param gender string
---@param restoring boolean
local function applyComponents(components, gender, restoring)
    local list = components.id and { components } or components

    for i = 1, #list do
        local entry = list[i]
        local componentId = entry.componentId or entry.id

        if restoring then
            local previous = stored[componentId]

            if previous then
                setComponent(componentId, previous.drawable, previous.texture)
            end

            stored[componentId] = nil
        elseif componentId ~= DECAL_COMPONENT or not halfped.wearingGranted(cache.ped) then
            stored[componentId] = componentState(componentId)

            local target = entry.drawableId or entry.drawable
            local texture = entry.textureId

            setComponent(componentId, target and (target[gender] or target.custom or 0) or 0,
                texture and texture[gender] or 0)
        end
    end
end

---@param props table
---@param gender string
---@param restoring boolean
local function applyProps(props, gender, restoring)
    local key = propKey(props.id)

    if restoring then
        local previous = stored[key]

        if previous then
            setProp(props.id, previous.prop, previous.texture)
        end

        stored[key] = nil

        return
    end

    stored[key] = propState(props.id)

    local target = props.drawable

    if not target then return end

    setProp(props.id, target[gender] or target.custom or -1, props.textureId and props.textureId[gender] or 0)
end

---@param itemName string
---@param hide boolean
---@param gender string
---@return boolean changed
local function setHidden(itemName, hide, gender)
    local item = config[itemName]

    if not item or isSwap(itemName) then return false end
    if clothing.hidden(itemName) == hide then return false end
    if hide and atDefault(itemName, gender) then return false end

    if item.components then applyComponents(item.components, gender, not hide) end
    if item.props then applyProps(item.props, gender, not hide) end

    return true
end

---@param itemName string
---@param gender string
---@return boolean
local function swap(itemName, gender)
    local item = config[itemName]
    local slot = item.components or item.props
    local isComponent = item.components ~= nil
    local slotId = slot.id
    local current = isComponent and componentState(slotId).drawable or propState(slotId).prop
    local target = slot.variation[gender] and slot.variation[gender][current] or lastVariation[itemName]

    if not target then
        lib.notify({ description = locale("clothing.noVariation"), type = "error" })

        return false
    end

    lastVariation[itemName] = current

    if isComponent then
        setComponent(slotId, target, componentState(slotId).texture)
    else
        setProp(slotId, target, propState(slotId).texture)
    end

    return true
end

local function restoreVariations()
    for itemName, previous in pairs(lastVariation) do
        local item = config[itemName]
        local slot = item and (item.components or item.props)

        if slot and slot.variation then
            local isComponent = item.components ~= nil
            local state = isComponent and componentState(slot.id) or propState(slot.id)
            local current = isComponent and state.drawable or state.prop

            if previous ~= current then
                if isComponent then
                    setComponent(slot.id, previous, state.texture)
                else
                    setProp(slot.id, previous, state.texture)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

---@param anim ClothingAnim|ClothingAnim[]|nil
---@param restoring boolean
---@return ClothingAnim?
local function animationFor(anim, restoring)
    if not anim then return end

    if anim[1] then
        return restoring and anim[2] or anim[1]
    end

    return anim
end

---@param anim ClothingAnim?
---@param apply fun()
local function run(anim, apply)
    if not anim then return apply() end

    cooldown = true

    CreateThread(function()
        lib.requestAnimDict(anim.dict)

        local flag = cache.vehicle and 51 or anim.flag or 0

        TaskPlayAnim(cache.ped, anim.dict, anim.clip, 3.0, 3.0, anim.duration or -1, flag, 0, false, false, false)

        Wait(math.max((anim.duration or 0) - 200, 200))

        apply()

        cooldown = false
    end)
end

---@return table<string, { hidden: boolean, swap: boolean, available: boolean }>
function clothing.status()
    local gender = clothing.gender()
    local status = {}

    for itemName in pairs(config) do
        local swapItem = isSwap(itemName)
        local hidden = clothing.hidden(itemName)

        status[itemName] = {
            hidden = hidden,
            swap = swapItem,
            available = swapItem and gender ~= "custom" or (not swapItem and (hidden or not atDefault(itemName, gender)))
        }
    end

    return status
end

function clothing.push()
    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({
        action = "clothing_status",
        data = clothing.status()
    }))
end

---@return boolean
function clothing.busy()
    return cooldown
end

---@return boolean
function clothing.anyHidden()
    return next(stored) ~= nil
end

---@param kind "component"|"prop"
---@param slotId number
---@return boolean cleared
function clothing.forget(kind, slotId)
    local key = kind == "prop" and propKey(slotId) or slotId
    local cleared = false

    for itemName in pairs(config) do
        local keys = slotKeys(itemName)
        local owns = false

        for i = 1, #keys do
            if keys[i] == key then
                owns = true
                break
            end
        end

        if owns then
            for i = 1, #keys do
                local previous = stored[keys[i]]

                if previous then
                    if keys[i] ~= key then
                        if previous.type == "prop" then
                            setProp(previous.id, previous.prop, previous.texture)
                        else
                            setComponent(previous.id, previous.drawable, previous.texture)
                        end
                    end

                    stored[keys[i]] = nil
                    cleared = true
                end
            end

            lastVariation[itemName] = nil
        end
    end

    return cleared
end

---@param itemName string
---@param animate boolean?
---@return boolean
function clothing.toggle(itemName, animate)
    if cooldown then return false end

    local item = config[itemName]

    if not item then return false end
    if throttled(itemName) then return false end

    local gender = clothing.gender()

    if isSwap(itemName) then
        if gender == "custom" then
            lib.notify({ description = locale("clothing.noVariation"), type = "error" })

            return false
        end

        run(animate and animationFor(item.anim, true) or nil, function()
            if swap(itemName, gender) then clothing.push() end
        end)

        return true
    end

    local hidden = clothing.hidden(itemName)

    if not hidden and atDefault(itemName, gender) then
        lib.notify({ description = locale("clothing.notWorn", locale("clothing." .. itemName)), type = "error" })

        return false
    end

    run(animate and animationFor(item.anim, not hidden) or nil, function()
        if setHidden(itemName, not hidden, gender) then clothing.push() end
    end)

    return true
end

---@param items string[]
---@return boolean changed
function clothing.toggleGroup(items)
    if cooldown then return false end
    if throttled(table.concat(items, ",")) then return false end

    local gender = clothing.gender()
    local hide = true

    for i = 1, #items do
        if clothing.hidden(items[i]) then
            hide = false
            break
        end
    end

    local changed = false

    for i = 1, #items do
        if setHidden(items[i], hide, gender) then changed = true end
    end

    if changed then clothing.push() end

    return changed
end

---@return boolean
function clothing.railOpen()
    return railOpen
end

function clothing.closeRail()
    if not railOpen then return end

    railOpen = false

    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    SetNuiFocusKeepInput(false)

    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({
        action = "clothing_hide",
        data = {}
    }))
end

function clothing.openRail()
    if railOpen then return end

    railOpen = true

    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
    SetNuiFocusKeepInput(true)

    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({
        action = "clothing_display",
        data = clothing.status()
    }))

    CreateThread(function()
        while railOpen do
            DisableControlAction(0, 1, true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 2, true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 24, true)
            DisableControlAction(0, 25, true)
            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

---@param animate boolean?
function clothing.reset(animate)
    if not clothing.anyHidden() and next(lastVariation) == nil then return end

    local function restore()
        for key, previous in pairs(stored) do
            if previous.type == "prop" then
                setProp(previous.id, previous.prop, previous.texture)
            else
                setComponent(previous.id, previous.drawable, previous.texture)
            end

            stored[key] = nil
        end

        restoreVariations()

        lastVariation = {}

        clothing.push()
    end

    run(animate and RESET_ANIM or nil, restore)
end

return clothing

########## FILE: \features\halfped.lua
local ped = require "core.ped"
local Net = require "modules.net"
local events = require "modules.events"

local DECALS = 10
local EMPTY = {}
local UNKNOWN = { blocked = EMPTY, granted = EMPTY, disabledFace = EMPTY }

---@type { blocked: table<string, number[]>, granted: table<string, number[]>, disabledFace: table<string, number> }?
local state

local halfped = {}

---@param data table?
local function accept(data)
    data = data or EMPTY

    state = {
        blocked = data.blocked or EMPTY,
        granted = data.granted or EMPTY,
        disabledFace = data.disabledFace or EMPTY
    }
end

---@return { blocked: table<string, number[]>, granted: table<string, number[]>, disabledFace: table<string, number> }
local function fetch()
    if state then return state end

    Net.awaitPush(function() return state end)

    return state or UNKNOWN
end

---@return boolean
function halfped.ready()
    return state ~= nil
end

---@param gender string
---@return number?
function halfped.disabledFace(gender)
    return fetch().disabledFace[gender]
end

---@param gender string
---@return number[]
function halfped.blockedDecals(gender)
    return fetch().blocked[gender] or EMPTY
end

---@param gender string
---@param drawable number
---@return boolean
function halfped.allowed(gender, drawable)
    local list = fetch().granted[gender]

    for i = 1, list and #list or 0 do
        if list[i] == drawable then return true end
    end

    return false
end

---@param gender string
---@return number?
function halfped.grantedDecal(gender)
    local list = fetch().granted[gender]

    return list and list[1] or nil
end

---@param gender string
---@param drawable number
---@return boolean
function halfped.registered(gender, drawable)
    if halfped.allowed(gender, drawable) then return true end

    local blocked = fetch().blocked[gender] or EMPTY

    for i = 1, #blocked do
        if blocked[i] == drawable then return true end
    end

    return false
end

---@param components PedComponent[]
---@param gender string
---@return PedComponent[]
function halfped.strip(components, gender)
    local result = table.create(#components, 0)

    fetch()

    local known = halfped.ready()

    for i = 1, #components do
        local piece = components[i]

        if piece.component_id ~= DECALS or (known and not halfped.registered(gender, piece.drawable)) then
            result[#result + 1] = piece
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@param gender string
---@return boolean
function halfped.hasAnyAccess(gender)
    return halfped.grantedDecal(gender) ~= nil
end

---@param entity number
---@return boolean
function halfped.wearingGranted(entity)
    if not ped.isFreemode(entity) then return false end

    return halfped.allowed(ped.gender(entity), GetPedDrawableVariation(entity, DECALS))
end

RegisterNetEvent("rhd_appearance:halfped:data", function(data)
    if source == '' then return end

    accept(data)

    events.emit("rhd_appearance:halfped:applied")
end)

---@param entity number
---@param index number
local function setFace(entity, index)
    local blend = ped.getHeadBlend(entity)

    blend.shapeFirst = index
    blend.shapeMix = 0.0

    ped.setHeadBlend(entity, blend)
end

---@param entity number
---@return number
local function currentFace(entity)
    return ped.getHeadBlend(entity).shapeFirst
end

---@param entity number
function halfped.clear(entity)
    setFace(entity, 0)
    ped.setComponent(entity, { component_id = DECALS, drawable = 0, texture = 0 })
end

---@param entity number
---@return boolean changed
function halfped.refresh(entity)
    if not ped.isFreemode(entity) then return false end

    fetch()

    if not halfped.ready() then return false end

    local gender = ped.gender(entity)
    local disabled = halfped.disabledFace(gender)

    if not disabled or currentFace(entity) ~= disabled then return false end

    if halfped.allowed(gender, GetPedDrawableVariation(entity, DECALS)) then return false end

    halfped.clear(entity)

    return true
end

---@param entity number
---@param componentId number
---@return boolean changed
function halfped.sync(entity, componentId)
    if componentId ~= DECALS then return false end

    local gender = ped.gender(entity)
    local disabled = halfped.disabledFace(gender)

    if not disabled then return false end

    if halfped.allowed(gender, GetPedDrawableVariation(entity, DECALS)) then return false end

    if currentFace(entity) ~= disabled then return false end

    setFace(entity, 0)

    return true
end

return halfped


########## FILE: \features\items.lua
local constants = require "data.constants"
local registry = require "modules.items"
local ped = require "core.ped"
local clothing = require "features.clothing"

---@type table<string, table<string, { drawable: number, texture: number }>>
local worn = {}

local items = {}

---@param slot string
---@return { category: string, id: number }
local function meta(slot)
    return constants.SLOTS[slot]
end

---@param slot string
---@return { drawable: number, texture: number }
local function current(slot)
    local entry = meta(slot)

    if entry.category == "components" then
        return {
            drawable = GetPedDrawableVariation(cache.ped, entry.id),
            texture = GetPedTextureVariation(cache.ped, entry.id)
        }
    end

    return {
        drawable = GetPedPropIndex(cache.ped, entry.id),
        texture = GetPedPropTextureIndex(cache.ped, entry.id)
    }
end

---@param slot string
---@param drawable number
---@param texture number
local function apply(slot, drawable, texture)
    local entry = meta(slot)

    if entry.category == "components" then
        SetPedComponentVariation(cache.ped, entry.id, drawable, texture, 0)

        return
    end

    if drawable < 0 then
        ClearPedProp(cache.ped, entry.id)
    else
        SetPedPropIndex(cache.ped, entry.id, drawable, texture, true)
    end
end

---@param name string
---@return boolean
function items.worn(name)
    return worn[name] ~= nil
end

---@return boolean
function items.anyWorn()
    return next(worn) ~= nil
end

---@return table<string, { drawable: number, texture: number }>
local function heldSlots()
    local held = {}

    for _, previous in pairs(worn) do
        for slot, piece in pairs(previous) do
            held[slot] = piece
        end
    end

    return held
end

---@param slot string
---@return boolean
function items.holds(slot)
    return heldSlots()[slot] ~= nil
end

---@param list table[]
---@param key string
---@return table[]
function items.without(list, key)
    local held = heldSlots()

    if not next(held) then return list end

    local components = key == "component_id"
    local taken = {}

    for slot in pairs(held) do
        local entry = meta(slot)

        if (entry.category == "components") == components then
            taken[entry.id] = true
        end
    end

    local result = table.create(#list, 0)

    for i = 1, #list do
        if not taken[list[i][key]] then
            result[#result + 1] = list[i]
        end
    end

    return result
end

---@param list table[]?
---@param swap table<number, { drawable: number, texture: number }>
---@param key string
---@return table[]?
local function replaced(list, swap, key)
    if not list then return list end

    local result = table.create(#list, 0)

    for i = 1, #list do
        local piece = list[i]
        local under = swap[piece[key]]

        result[i] = under and { [key] = piece[key], drawable = under.drawable, texture = under.texture } or piece
    end

    return result
end

---@param appearance PedAppearance
---@return PedAppearance
function items.underneath(appearance)
    local held = heldSlots()

    if not next(held) then return appearance end

    local swap = { components = {}, props = {} }

    for slot, piece in pairs(held) do
        local entry = meta(slot)

        swap[entry.category][entry.id] = piece
    end

    local result = {}

    for key, value in pairs(appearance) do
        result[key] = value
    end

    result.components = replaced(appearance.components, swap.components, "component_id")
    result.props = replaced(appearance.props, swap.props, "prop_id")

    return result
end

---@param look ClothingItemLook
---@param except string
---@return boolean
local function slotTaken(look, except)
    for name, taken in pairs(worn) do
        if name ~= except then
            for slot in pairs(look) do
                if taken[slot] then return true end
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param name string
---@return boolean
function items.wear(name)
    if worn[name] then return false end

    if not ped.isFreemode(cache.ped) then
        lib.notify({ description = locale("items.wrongModel"), type = "error" })

        return false
    end

    local look = registry.look(name, ped.gender(cache.ped))

    if not look then
        lib.notify({ description = locale("items.wrongModel"), type = "error" })

        return false
    end

    if slotTaken(look, name) then
        lib.notify({ description = locale("items.slotTaken"), type = "error" })

        return false
    end

    local previous = {}

    for slot, piece in pairs(look) do
        local entry = meta(slot)

        clothing.forget(entry.category == "props" and "prop" or "component", entry.id)

        previous[slot] = current(slot)

        apply(slot, piece.drawable, piece.texture or 0)
    end

    worn[name] = previous

    return true
end

---@param name string
---@return boolean
function items.remove(name)
    local previous = worn[name]

    if not previous then return false end

    worn[name] = nil

    for slot, piece in pairs(previous) do
        apply(slot, piece.drawable, piece.texture)
    end

    return true
end

---@param name string
---@return boolean worn
function items.toggle(name)
    if worn[name] then
        items.remove(name)

        return false
    end

    return items.wear(name)
end

function items.reapply()
    if not next(worn) then return end

    local freemode = ped.isFreemode(cache.ped)
    local gender = ped.gender(cache.ped)

    for name, previous in pairs(worn) do
        local look = freemode and registry.look(name, gender) or nil

        if not look then
            worn[name] = nil
        else
            for slot, piece in pairs(look) do
                previous[slot] = current(slot)

                apply(slot, piece.drawable, piece.texture or 0)
            end
        end
    end
end

function items.clear()
    for name in pairs(worn) do
        items.remove(name)
    end
end

return items


########## FILE: \features\menu.lua
local menus = {}
local currentMenu = nil
local returnMenu = nil
local dialogPromise = nil

---@param action string
---@param data table
local function send(action, data)
    SendNuiMessage(json.encode({ action = action, data = data }))
end

---@param menu MenuDefinition
---@return table
local function serialise(menu)
    local options = {}

    for i = 1, #menu.options do
        local option = menu.options[i]

        options[i] = {
            title = option.title,
            description = option.description,
            submenu = option.menu ~= nil
        }
    end

    return {
        title = menu.title,
        hasParent = menu.menu ~= nil,
        options = options
    }
end

local menu = {}

function menu.close()
    currentMenu = nil
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    send("menu_hide", {})
end

---@return boolean
function menu.active()
    return currentMenu ~= nil or dialogPromise ~= nil
end

---@param definition MenuDefinition
function menu.register(definition)
    menus[definition.id] = definition
end

---@param id string
function menu.show(id)
    local definition = menus[id]

    if not definition then return end

    currentMenu = id
    send("menu_display", serialise(definition))
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
end

---@param title string
---@param fields DialogField[]
---@return string[]? values one entry per field, nil when cancelled
function menu.input(title, fields)
    if dialogPromise then return end

    dialogPromise = promise.new()
    send("menu_dialog", { title = title, fields = fields })
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)

    local result = Citizen.Await(dialogPromise)
    dialogPromise = nil

    if returnMenu then
        menu.show(returnMenu)
    else
        SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    end

    if result == false then return end

    return result
end

RegisterNUICallback("menu_select", function(data, cb)
    cb(1)

    local definition = menus[currentMenu]
    local option = definition and definition.options[data.index]

    if not option then return end

    if option.menu then
        return menu.show(option.menu)
    end

    returnMenu = currentMenu
    menu.close()

    if option.onSelect then
        option.onSelect(option.args)
    end
end)

RegisterNUICallback("menu_back", function(_, cb)
    cb(1)

    local definition = menus[currentMenu]

    if definition and definition.menu then
        return menu.show(definition.menu)
    end

    menu.close()
end)

RegisterNUICallback("menu_close", function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    returnMenu = nil
    menu.close()
end)

RegisterNUICallback("menu_dialog_submit", function(data, cb)
    cb(1)

    if not dialogPromise then return end

    dialogPromise:resolve(data.values or false)
end)

return menu


########## FILE: \features\oplas.lua
local config = require "config.menu"
local editor = require "core.editor"
local shops = require "features.shops"

local oplas = {}

---@return table
local function menu()
    local conf = table.clone(config.default)

    conf.ped = true
    conf.headBlend = true
    conf.faceFeatures = true
    conf.headOverlays = true
    conf.components = true
    conf.props = true

    return conf
end

---@return boolean
local function busy()
    return editor.active()
        or cache.vehicle and true
        or IsPedFalling(cache.ped)
        or IsPedRagdoll(cache.ped)
        or IsPedDeadOrDying(cache.ped, true)
end

---@return boolean saved
function oplas.open()
    if busy() then
        lib.notify({ description = locale("oplas.busy"), type = "error" })

        return false
    end

    local conf = menu()

    local done = promise.new()
    local settled = false
    local opened = false

    ---@param saved boolean
    local function settle(saved)
        if settled then return end

        settled = true

        done:resolve(saved)
    end

    shops.clear()

    CreateThread(function()
        editor.open(conf, function(appearance)
            opened = true

            settle(appearance ~= nil)

            return appearance ~= nil
        end)

        if not editor.active() and not opened then
            settle(false)
        end
    end)

    return Citizen.Await(done)
end

return oplas


########## FILE: \features\outfits.lua
local ped = require "core.ped"
local editor = require "core.editor"
local settings = require "core.settings"
local halfped = require "features.halfped"
local worn = require "features.items"
local menu = require "features.menu"
local shops = require "config.shops"

local MAIN = "rhd_appearance_outfits"
local CHANGE = "rhd_appearance_outfits_change"
local UPDATE = "rhd_appearance_outfits_update"
local DELETE = "rhd_appearance_outfits_delete"
local SHARE = "rhd_appearance_outfits_share"
local JOB = "rhd_appearance_outfits_job"

local outfits = {}

---@type { components: PedComponent[], props: PedProp[] }?
local previewed

---@type number?
local previewing

---@param message string
---@param kind string?
local function notify(message, kind)
    lib.notify({ description = message, type = kind })
end

---@return Outfit[]
local function fetch()
    return lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:get", false) or {}
end

---@return string model
---@return PedComponent[]
---@return PedProp[]
local function currentOutfit()
    local components = halfped.strip(ped.getComponents(cache.ped), ped.gender(cache.ped))

    return ped.getModel(cache.ped), components, ped.getProps(cache.ped)
end

---@param model string
---@param components PedComponent[]
---@param props PedProp[]
---@return boolean
local function saveable(model, components, props)
    local slot = settings.blocked({ model = model, components = components, props = props })

    if not slot then return true end

    notify(locale("items.blocked", settings.label(slot)), "error")

    return false
end

---@param outfit Outfit
---@return boolean
local function wearable(outfit)
    local slot = settings.blocked({ model = outfit.model, components = outfit.components, props = outfit.props })

    if not slot then return true end

    notify(locale("outfits.blocked", settings.label(slot)), "error")

    return false
end

---@param outfit Outfit
local function dress(outfit)
    worn.reapply()

    local components = halfped.strip(outfit.components, ped.gender(cache.ped))

    ped.setComponents(cache.ped, worn.without(components, "component_id"))
    ped.setProps(cache.ped, worn.without(outfit.props, "prop_id"))
end

---@param outfit Outfit
local function wear(outfit)
    if not wearable(outfit) then return end

    if ped.getModel(cache.ped) ~= outfit.model then
        local stored = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:get", false, outfit.model)

        if not stored then
            return notify(locale("outfits.wrongModel"), "error")
        end

        ped.applyToPlayer(stored)
    end

    dress(outfit)

    editor.commit(worn.underneath(ped.get(cache.ped)))
    notify(locale("outfits.worn", outfit.name))
end

local function save()
    local response = menu.input(locale("outfits.save.title"), {
        {
            type = "input",
            label = locale("outfits.save.name"),
            required = true
        }
    })

    if not response then return end

    local model, components, props = currentOutfit()
    local saved = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:save", false, response[1], model, components, props)

    notify(saved and locale("outfits.saved") or locale("outfits.saveFailed"), not saved and "error" or nil)
end

---@param outfit Outfit
local function update(outfit)
    local model, components, props = currentOutfit()
    local updated = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:update", false, outfit.id, model, components, props)

    notify(updated and locale("outfits.updated") or locale("outfits.updateFailed"), not updated and "error" or nil)
end

---@param outfit Outfit
local function remove(outfit)
    local deleted = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:delete", false, outfit.id)

    notify(deleted and locale("outfits.deleted") or locale("outfits.deleteFailed"), not deleted and "error" or nil)
end

---@param outfit Outfit
local function share(outfit)
    local code = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:generateCode", false, outfit.id)

    if not code then
        return notify(locale("outfits.codeFailed"), "error")
    end

    lib.setClipboard(code)

    menu.input(locale("outfits.share.title"), {
        {
            type = "input",
            label = locale("outfits.share.code"),
            default = code,
            disabled = true
        }
    })
end

local function import()
    local response = menu.input(locale("outfits.import.title"), {
        {
            type = "input",
            label = locale("outfits.import.name"),
            required = true
        },
        {
            type = "input",
            label = locale("outfits.import.code"),
            required = true
        }
    })

    if not response then return end

    local imported = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:import", false, response[1], response[2])

    notify(imported and locale("outfits.imported") or locale("outfits.importFailed"), not imported and "error" or nil)
end

---@param id string
---@param title string
---@param list Outfit[]
---@param action fun(outfit: Outfit)
local function registerList(id, title, list, action)
    local options = table.create(#list, 0)

    for i = 1, #list do
        options[i] = {
            title = list[i].name,
            description = list[i].model,
            onSelect = action,
            args = list[i]
        }
    end

    table.sort(options, function(a, b) return a.title < b.title end)

    menu.register({ id = id, title = title, menu = MAIN, options = options })
end

---@return Outfit[]
function outfits.list()
    return fetch()
end

---@param id number
---@return Outfit?
local function byId(id)
    local list = fetch()

    for i = 1, #list do
        if list[i].id == id then return list[i] end
    end
end

---@param id number
---@return boolean
function outfits.apply(id)
    local outfit = byId(id)

    if not outfit then
        notify(locale("outfits.missing"), "error")

        return false
    end

    if not wearable(outfit) then return false end

    previewing = nil
    previewed = nil

    if ped.getModel(cache.ped) ~= outfit.model then
        local stored = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:get", false, outfit.model)

        if not stored then
            notify(locale("outfits.wrongModel"), "error")

            return false
        end

        ped.applyToPlayer(stored)
    end

    dress(outfit)

    notify(locale("outfits.worn", outfit.name), "success")

    return true
end

---@param id number
---@return boolean
function outfits.preview(id)
    previewing = id

    local outfit = byId(id)

    if previewing ~= id then return false end

    if not outfit or ped.getModel(cache.ped) ~= outfit.model then return false end

    if not previewed then
        previewed = { components = ped.getComponents(cache.ped), props = ped.getProps(cache.ped) }
    end

    dress(outfit)

    return true
end

function outfits.endPreview()
    previewing = nil

    if not previewed then return end

    ped.setComponents(cache.ped, previewed.components)
    ped.setProps(cache.ped, previewed.props)

    previewed = nil
end

---@param name string
---@return boolean
function outfits.store(name)
    local model, components, props = currentOutfit()

    if not saveable(model, components, props) then return false end

    local saved = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:save", false, name, model, components, props)

    notify(saved and locale("outfits.saved") or locale("outfits.saveFailed"), not saved and "error" or nil)

    return saved == true
end

---@param id number
---@return boolean
function outfits.overwrite(id)
    local model, components, props = currentOutfit()

    if not saveable(model, components, props) then return false end

    local updated = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:update", false, id, model, components, props)

    notify(updated and locale("outfits.updated") or locale("outfits.updateFailed"), not updated and "error" or nil)

    return updated == true
end

---@param id number
---@return boolean
function outfits.delete(id)
    local deleted = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:delete", false, id)

    notify(deleted and locale("outfits.deleted") or locale("outfits.deleteFailed"), not deleted and "error" or nil)

    return deleted == true
end

---@param id number
---@return string?
function outfits.code(id)
    local code = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:generateCode", false, id)

    if not code then
        notify(locale("outfits.codeFailed"), "error")

        return
    end

    lib.setClipboard(code)
    notify(locale("outfits.share.code"))

    return code
end

---@param name string
---@param code string
---@return boolean
function outfits.import(name, code)
    local imported = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:outfits:import", false, name, code)

    notify(imported and locale("outfits.imported") or locale("outfits.importFailed"), not imported and "error" or nil)

    return imported == true
end

function outfits.open()
    local list = fetch()

    registerList(CHANGE, locale("outfits.change.title"), list, wear)
    registerList(UPDATE, locale("outfits.update.title"), list, update)
    registerList(DELETE, locale("outfits.delete.title"), list, remove)
    registerList(SHARE, locale("outfits.share.title"), list, share)

    menu.register({
        id = MAIN,
        title = locale("outfits.title"),
        options = {
            { title = locale("outfits.change.title"), description = locale("outfits.change.description"), menu = CHANGE },
            { title = locale("outfits.update.title"), description = locale("outfits.update.description"), menu = UPDATE },
            { title = locale("outfits.save.title"), description = locale("outfits.save.description"), onSelect = save },
            { title = locale("outfits.share.title"), description = locale("outfits.share.description"), menu = SHARE },
            { title = locale("outfits.delete.title"), description = locale("outfits.delete.description"), menu = DELETE },
            { title = locale("outfits.import.title"), description = locale("outfits.import.description"), onSelect = import }
        }
    })

    menu.show(MAIN)
end

---@param room ShopZone
function outfits.openJob(room)
    local group = room.job or room.gang

    if not group then return end

    local gender = ped.gender(cache.ped)
    local model = ped.getModel(cache.ped)
    local uniforms = shops.jobOutfits[group] or {}
    local options = {}

    for i = 1, #uniforms do
        local uniform = uniforms[i]

        if not uniform.gender or uniform.gender == gender then
            options[#options + 1] = {
                title = uniform.name,
                onSelect = wear,
                args = {
                    name = uniform.name,
                    model = uniform.model or model,
                    components = uniform.components or {},
                    props = uniform.props or {}
                }
            }
        end
    end

    if #options == 0 then
        return notify(locale("shops.noUniforms"), "error")
    end

    menu.register({ id = JOB, title = locale("shops.clothingRoom"), options = options })
    menu.show(JOB)
end

return outfits


########## FILE: \features\shops.lua
local config = require "config.shops"
local clientConfig = require "config.editor"
local menuConfig = require "config.menu"
local ped = require "core.ped"
local editor = require "core.editor"
local outfits = require "features.outfits"
local menuUI = require "features.menu"

local INTERACT_KEY = 38
local INFO_ID = "sm_appearance"
local DEFAULT_ICON = "fa-solid fa-shirt"

local SECTIONS = {
    clothing = { components = true, props = true },
    barber = { headOverlays = true },
    tattoo = { tattoos = true },
    surgeon = { headBlend = true, faceFeatures = true }
}

local shops = {}

---@param shopType string
---@return table?
function shops.menu(shopType)
    local sections = SECTIONS[shopType]

    if not sections then return end

    local menu = table.clone(menuConfig.default)

    for key, value in pairs(sections) do
        menu[key] = value
    end

    return menu
end

---@type { kind: string, index: number, info: table }?
local current

---@type boolean
local infoVisible = false

---@type string?
local openShop

---@type number
local billedTattoos = 0

---@type number[]
local blips = {}

---@param zone ShopZone
---@return boolean
local function permitted(zone)
    if not zone.job and not zone.gang and not zone.identifiers then return true end

    if zone.job and Framework.holdsJob(zone.job) then return true end
    if zone.gang and Framework.holdsGang(zone.gang) then return true end

    if zone.identifiers then
        local identifier = Framework.getState().identifier

        for i = 1, #zone.identifiers do
            if zone.identifiers[i] == identifier then return true end
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param shopType string
function shops.open(shopType)
    local menu = shops.menu(shopType)

    if not menu or editor.active() then return end

    openShop = shopType
    billedTattoos = 0

    editor.open(menu, function(appearance)
        openShop = nil

        if not appearance then return end

        if shopType == "tattoo" and clientConfig.chargePerTattoo then return end

        return lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:shops:charge", false, shopType)
    end)
end

function shops.clear()
    openShop = nil
    billedTattoos = 0
end

---@param a { drawable: number, texture: number }[]
---@param b { drawable: number, texture: number }[]
---@return boolean
local function wornAlike(a, b)
    if #a ~= #b then return false end

    for i = 1, #a do
        if a[i].drawable ~= b[i].drawable or a[i].texture ~= b[i].texture then return false end
    end

    return true
end

---@return boolean
function shops.unpaid()
    if not openShop then return false end

    local snapshot = editor.original()

    if not snapshot then return true end

    return not wornAlike(ped.getComponents(cache.ped), snapshot.components)
        or not wornAlike(ped.getProps(cache.ped), snapshot.props)
end

---@param list PedTattoos
---@return number
local function countTattoos(list)
    local total = 0

    for _, zone in pairs(list) do
        total += #zone
    end

    return total
end

---@param list PedTattoos
---@return boolean
function shops.allowTattoo(list)
    if openShop ~= "tattoo" or not clientConfig.chargePerTattoo then return true end

    local total = countTattoos(list)

    for _ = billedTattoos + 1, total do
        if not lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:shops:chargeTattoo", false) then return false end

        billedTattoos += 1
    end

    billedTattoos = total

    return true
end

---@param kind string
---@param index number
local function activate(kind, index)
    if kind == "clothingRoom" then
        local room = config.clothingRooms[index]

        if permitted(room) then outfits.openJob(room) end
    elseif kind == "outfitRoom" then
        if permitted(config.outfitRooms[index]) then outfits.open() end
    else
        local store = config.stores[index]

        if permitted(store) then shops.open(store.type) end
    end
end

local function showInfo()
    if infoVisible or not current then return end

    infoVisible = true

    exports.sm_resource_1:infoShow(current.info)
end

local function hideInfo()
    if not infoVisible then return end

    infoVisible = false

    exports.sm_resource_1:infoRemove(INFO_ID)
end

---@param zone ShopZone
---@param kind string
local function onEnter(zone, kind, index)
    if not permitted(zone) then return end

    local kindKey = zone.type or kind
    local cost = config.costs[zone.type]
    local label = locale("shops." .. kindKey)

    current = {
        kind = kind,
        index = index,
        info = {
            id = INFO_ID,
            title = label,
            icon = config.icons[kindKey] or DEFAULT_ICON,
            description = cost and ("[kbd]E[/kbd] %s ($%d)"):format(label, cost)
                or ("[kbd]E[/kbd] %s"):format(label)
        }
    }

    showInfo()
end

local function onExit()
    current = nil

    hideInfo()
end

---@param zone ShopZone
---@return boolean
local function enabled(zone)
    local disabled = config.disabledTypes

    return not (zone.type and disabled and disabled[zone.type])
end

---@param list ShopZone[]
---@param kind string
local function buildZones(list, kind)
    for i = 1, #list do
        local zone = list[i]

        if not enabled(zone) then goto continue end

        local options = {
            debug = config.debug,
            onEnter = function() onEnter(zone, kind, i) end,
            onExit = onExit
        }

        if zone.points then
            options.points = zone.points

            lib.zones.poly(options)
        else
            options.coords = zone.coords
            options.size = zone.size or vec3(4, 4, 4)
            options.rotation = zone.rotation or 0.0

            lib.zones.box(options)
        end

        ::continue::
    end
end

---@param list ShopZone[]
---@param kind string
local function buildBlips(list, kind)
    for i = 1, #list do
        local zone = list[i]
        local settings = config.blips[zone.type or kind]
        local show = zone.showBlip

        if show == nil then show = settings and settings.show end
        if not enabled(zone) then show = false end

        if show and settings then
            local name = zone.type or kind
            local key = "rhd_appearance_blip_" .. name
            local blip = AddBlipForCoord(zone.coords.x, zone.coords.y, zone.coords.z)

            SetBlipSprite(blip, settings.sprite)
            SetBlipColour(blip, settings.color)
            SetBlipScale(blip, settings.scale)
            SetBlipDisplay(blip, 4)
            SetBlipAsShortRange(blip, true)
            AddTextEntry(key, locale("shops." .. name))
            BeginTextCommandSetBlipName(key)
            EndTextCommandSetBlipName(blip)

            blips[#blips + 1] = blip
        end
    end
end

local function interactLoop()
    while true do
        local wait = 500

        if current then
            wait = 0

            if editor.active() or menuUI.active() then
                hideInfo()
            else
                showInfo()

                if IsControlJustReleased(0, INTERACT_KEY) then
                    hideInfo()
                    activate(current.kind, current.index)
                end
            end
        end

        Wait(wait)
    end
end
CreateThread(function()
    local groups = {
        { list = config.stores, kind = "store" },
        { list = config.clothingRooms, kind = "clothingRoom" },
        { list = config.outfitRooms, kind = "outfitRoom" }
    }

    for i = 1, #groups do
        local group = groups[i]

        buildBlips(group.list, group.kind)
        buildZones(group.list, group.kind)
    end

    interactLoop()
end)

AddEventHandler("onResourceStop", function(resource)
    if resource ~= cache.resource then return end

    hideInfo()

    for i = 1, #blips do
        RemoveBlip(blips[i])
    end
end)

return shops


########## FILE: \modules\cache.lua
local INTERVAL = 60000

---@type Cache[]
local registry = {}
local ticking = false

---@class Cache: OxClass
---@field rows table[]
---@field writer { update: fun(id: number, row: table), remove: fun(id: number) }
---@field updates table<number, table>
---@field deletes table<number, true>
local Cache = lib.class('AppearanceCache')

---@param writer { update: fun(id: number, row: table), remove: fun(id: number) }
function Cache:constructor(writer)
    self.rows = {}
    self.writer = writer
    self.updates = {}
    self.deletes = {}

    registry[#registry + 1] = self
end

---@param rows table[]
function Cache:load(rows)
    self.rows = rows or {}
    self.updates = {}
    self.deletes = {}
end

---@return table[]
function Cache:all()
    return self.rows
end

---@param id number
---@return table? row
---@return number? index
function Cache:find(id)
    for i = 1, #self.rows do
        if self.rows[i].id == id then return self.rows[i], i end
    end
end

function Cache:beforeInsert()
    if next(self.deletes) == nil then return end

    self:flush()
end

---@param row table
function Cache:insert(row)
    local existing, index = self:find(row.id)

    if existing then
        self.rows[index] = row
    else
        self.rows[#self.rows + 1] = row
    end

    self.updates[row.id] = nil
end

---@param id number
---@param row table
function Cache:update(id, row)
    local _, index = self:find(id)

    row.id = id

    if index then
        self.rows[index] = row
    else
        self.rows[#self.rows + 1] = row
    end

    self.updates[id] = row
end

---@param id number
---@param match fun(row: table): boolean
function Cache:removeWhere(id, match)
    for i = #self.rows, 1, -1 do
        if match(self.rows[i]) then table.remove(self.rows, i) end
    end

    self.updates[id] = nil
    self.deletes[id] = true
end

---@param match fun(row: table): boolean
function Cache:forget(match)
    for i = #self.rows, 1, -1 do
        local row = self.rows[i]

        if match(row) then
            table.remove(self.rows, i)
            self.updates[row.id] = nil
        end
    end
end

---@param id number
function Cache:remove(id)
    self:removeWhere(id, function(row) return row.id == id end)
end

---@return boolean
function Cache:pending()
    return next(self.updates) ~= nil or next(self.deletes) ~= nil
end

function Cache:flush()
    for id, row in pairs(self.updates) do
        self.writer.update(id, row)
    end

    for id in pairs(self.deletes) do
        self.writer.remove(id)
    end

    self.updates = {}
    self.deletes = {}
end

local cache = {}

---@param writer { update: fun(id: number, row: table), remove: fun(id: number) }
---@return Cache
function cache.new(writer)
    if not ticking then
        ticking = true

        CreateThread(function()
            while true do
                Wait(INTERVAL)
                cache.flush()
            end
        end)
    end

    return Cache:new(writer)
end

function cache.flush()
    for i = 1, #registry do
        if registry[i]:pending() then registry[i]:flush() end
    end
end

AddEventHandler("onResourceStop", function(resource)
    if resource == GetCurrentResourceName() then cache.flush() end
end)

return cache


########## FILE: \modules\events.lua
local handlers = {}

local events = {}

---@param name string
---@param fn function
function events.on(name, fn)
    local list = handlers[name]

    if not list then
        list = {}
        handlers[name] = list
    end

    list[#list + 1] = fn
end

---@param name string
---@param ... any
---@return boolean allowed
function events.emit(name, ...)
    local list = handlers[name]

    if not list then return true end

    for i = 1, #list do
        local ok, response = pcall(list[i], ...)

        if not ok then
            lib.print.error(("handler %d for '%s' failed: %s"):format(i, name, response))
        elseif response == false then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

return events


########## FILE: \modules\items.lua
local config = require "config.items"
local constants = require "data.constants"

---@type table<string, BlacklistEntry[]>?
local cache

local items = {}

---@return table<string, BlacklistEntry[]>
local function index()
    if cache then return cache end

    cache = {}

    ---@type table<string, table<number, number[]|false>>
    local byDrawable = {}

    for name, genders in pairs(config) do
        for gender, look in pairs(genders) do
            for slot, piece in pairs(look) do
                if not constants.SLOTS[slot] then
                    error(("rhd_appearance: item '%s' uses unknown slot '%s'"):format(name, slot))
                end

                if not piece.free then
                    local key = gender .. "/" .. slot
                    local drawables = byDrawable[key]

                    if not drawables then
                        drawables = {}
                        byDrawable[key] = drawables
                    end

                    local current = drawables[piece.drawable]

                    if piece.texture == nil then
                        drawables[piece.drawable] = false
                    elseif current ~= false then
                        current = current or {}
                        current[#current + 1] = piece.texture
                        drawables[piece.drawable] = current
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for key, drawables in pairs(byDrawable) do
        local entries = {}
        local whole = {}

        for drawable, textures in pairs(drawables) do
            if textures == false then
                whole[#whole + 1] = drawable
            else
                entries[#entries + 1] = { drawables = { drawable }, textures = textures }
            end
        end

        if #whole > 0 then
            entries[#entries + 1] = { drawables = whole }
        end

        cache[key] = entries
    end

    return cache
end

---@param gender string
---@param slot string
---@return BlacklistEntry[]?
function items.entries(gender, slot)
    return index()[gender .. "/" .. slot]
end

---@param gender string
---@param slot string
---@param drawable number
---@param texture number
---@return boolean
function items.blocks(gender, slot, drawable, texture)
    local entries = items.entries(gender, slot)

    if not entries then return false end

    for i = 1, #entries do
        local entry = entries[i]
        local list = entry.drawables

        for j = 1, #list do
            if list[j] == drawable then
                if not entry.textures then return true end

                for k = 1, #entry.textures do
                    if entry.textures[k] == texture then return true end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param name string
---@param gender string
---@return ClothingItemLook?
function items.look(name, gender)
    local entry = config[name]

    return entry and entry[gender]
end

---@param name string
---@return boolean
function items.exists(name)
    return config[name] ~= nil
end

return items


########## FILE: \modules\net.lua
local Net = {}

---@param event string
---@param player number
---@param ... any
function Net.emitLatentClient(event, player, ...)
    local payload = msgpack.pack_args(...)
    local payloadLen = #payload
    local bps = payloadLen + 1000
    TriggerLatentClientEventInternal(event, player --[[@as string]], payload, payloadLen, bps)
end

---@generic T
---@param get fun(): T?
---@param timeout number?
---@return T?
function Net.awaitPush(get, timeout)
    local value = get()

    if value ~= nil then return value end

    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + (timeout or 5000)

    repeat
        Wait(0)
        value = get()
    until value ~= nil or GetGameTimer() > deadline

    return value
end

return Net

local blacklist = require "server.blacklist"

local EVENT = "rhd_appearance:admin:data"

local admin = {}

---@param source number
---@return boolean
local function isAdmin(source)
    return IsPlayerAceAllowed(source, config.adminAce)
end

---@return table
local function snapshot()
    return {
        allowed = true,
        entries = blacklist.entries(),
        blacklistSync = blacklist.syncState(),
        peds = peds.snapshot(),
        pedCatalogue = pedsCatalogue.all(),
        halfPeds = halfped.all(),
        access = halfped.allAccess(),
        disabledFace = halfpedConfig.disabledFace
    }
end

---@param source number
---@return boolean sent
function admin.push(source)
    if not isAdmin(source) then return false end

    Net.emitLatentClient(EVENT, source, snapshot())

    return true
end

---@param name string
---@param handler fun(source: number, data: any): any
local function action(name, handler)
    lib.callback.register(name, function(source, data)
        if not isAdmin(source) then return false end

        local result = handler(source, data)

        if result then
            admin.push(source)
            sync.push(source)
        end

        return result
    end)
end

local state = require "server.storage.state"

local cache = require "modules.cache"
