local DECAL_COMPONENT = 10

local GENDERS = { male = true, female = true }
local CATEGORIES = { components = true, props = true, hair = true }

local GENDER_BY_MODEL = {
    [shared.freemodeModels.male] = "male",
    [shared.freemodeModels.female] = "female"
}

local SLOT_BY_ID = { components = {}, props = {} }

for name, slot in pairs(constants.SLOTS) do
    SLOT_BY_ID[slot.category][slot.id] = name
end

local store = cache.new({ update = storage.update, remove = storage.remove })
local imported = false
local loaded = false

local blacklist = {}

---@return boolean
function blacklist.loaded()
    return loaded
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
local function validTextures(value)
    if value == nil then return true end
    if type(value) ~= "table" or #value > 64 then return false end

    for i = 1, #value do
        if not validate.number(value[i], 0, 255) then return false end
    end

    return true
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
function blacklist.validEntry(value)
    return type(value) == "table"
        and GENDERS[value.gender] ~= nil
        and CATEGORIES[value.category] ~= nil
        and type(value.slot) == "string"
        and #value.slot <= 30
        and validate.number(value.drawable, 0, 4096)
        and validTextures(value.textures)
        and validate.requireJobs(value.jobs)
        and validate.requireJobs(value.gangs)
        and validate.strings(value.aces, 32)
        and validate.strings(value.citizenids, 64)
end

local function reload()
    store:load(storage.all())
    imported = state.synced()[SECTION] == true
    loaded = true
end

---@return BlacklistRow[]
local function flattenConfig()
    local flat = {}

    for gender, group in pairs(configEntries) do
        for category, slots in pairs(group) do
            local lists = category == "hair" and { [""] = slots } or slots

            for slot, entries in pairs(lists) do
                for i = 1, #entries do
                    local entry = entries[i]
                    local drawables = entry.drawables or {}

                    for j = 1, #drawables do
                        flat[#flat + 1] = {
                            gender = gender,
                            category = category,
                            slot = slot,
                            drawable = drawables[j],
                            textures = entry.textures,
                            jobs = entry.jobs,
                            gangs = entry.gangs,
                            aces = entry.aces,
                            citizenids = entry.identifiers or entry.citizenids
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return flat
end

---@param row table
---@return string
local function key(row)
    return ("%s/%s/%s/%d"):format(row.gender, row.category, row.slot, row.drawable)
end

---@return BlacklistRow[]
local function pending()
    local seen = {}
    local rows = store:all()

    for i = 1, #rows do
        seen[key(rows[i])] = true
    end

    local flat = flattenConfig()
    local missing = {}

    for i = 1, #flat do
        if not seen[key(flat[i])] then
            missing[#missing + 1] = flat[i]
        end
    end

    return missing
end

---@return BlacklistRow[]
function blacklist.entries()
    return store:all()
end

---@param into table<string, true>
function blacklist.aceNames(into)
    local rows = store:all()

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local aces = rows[i].aces

        for j = 1, aces and #aces or 0 do
            into[aces[j]] = true
        end
    end

    if imported then return end

    local flat = flattenConfig()

    for i = 1, #flat do
        local aces = flat[i].aces

        for j = 1, aces and #aces or 0 do
            into[aces[j]] = true
        end
    end
end

---@return { imported: boolean, pending: number }
function blacklist.syncState()
    return { imported = imported, pending = #pending() }
end

---@return table
local function payload()
    local rows = store:all()
    local entries = {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        local key = row.gender .. "/" .. row.category .. "/" .. row.slot
        local list = entries[key]

        if not list then
            list = {}
            entries[key] = list
        end

        list[#list + 1] = {
            drawables = { row.drawable },
            textures = row.textures,
            jobs = row.jobs,
            gangs = row.gangs,
            aces = row.aces,
            identifiers = row.citizenids
        }
    end

    return { entries = entries, imported = imported }
end

---@param source number
function blacklist.publish(source)
    Net.emitLatentClient(EVENT, source, payload())
end

---@param row table
---@param source number
---@param identifier string?
---@return boolean
local function unlockedFor(row, source, identifier)
    if row.jobs and Framework.playerHoldsJob(source, row.jobs) then return true end
    if row.gangs and Framework.playerHoldsGang(source, row.gangs) then return true end

    if row.aces then
        for i = 1, #row.aces do
            if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], row.aces[i]) then return true end
        end
    end

    local ids = row.citizenids

    if ids and identifier then
        for i = 1, #ids do
            if ids[i] == identifier then return true end
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param row table
---@param drawable number
---@param texture number
---@return boolean
local function rowBlocks(row, drawable, texture)
    if row.drawable ~= drawable then return false end

    local textures = row.textures

    if not textures or #textures == 0 then return true end

    for i = 1, #textures do
        if textures[i] == texture then return true end
    end

    return false
end

---@param gender string
---@param category string
---@param slot string
---@return table[]
local function rowsFor(gender, category, slot)
    local rows = {}
    local stored = store:all()

    for i = 1, #stored do
        local row = stored[i]

        if row.gender == gender and row.category == category and row.slot == slot then
            rows[#rows + 1] = row
        end
    end

    if imported then return rows end

    local group = configEntries[gender]

    if not group then return rows end

    ---@type BlacklistEntry[]
    local entries = (category == "hair" and group.hair or group[category] and group[category][slot]) or {}

    for i = 1, #entries do
        local entry = entries[i]
        local drawables = entry.drawables or {}

        for j = 1, #drawables do
            rows[#rows + 1] = {
                drawable = drawables[j],
                textures = entry.textures,
                jobs = entry.jobs,
                gangs = entry.gangs,
                aces = entry.aces,
                citizenids = entry.identifiers or entry.citizenids
            }
        end
    end

    return rows
end

---@param source number
---@param appearance table
---@return string? slot
function blacklist.blocks(source, appearance)
    local gender = GENDER_BY_MODEL[appearance.model]

    if not gender then return end

    local identifier = Framework.GetIdentifier(source)

    ---@param category string
    ---@param slot string
    ---@param drawable number
    ---@param texture number
    ---@return boolean
    local function blocked(category, slot, drawable, texture)
        local rows = rowsFor(gender, category, slot)

        for i = 1, #rows do
            local row = rows[i]

            if rowBlocks(row, drawable, texture) and not unlockedFor(row, source, identifier) then
                return true
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    local components = appearance.components or {}

    for i = 1, #components do
        local piece = components[i]
        local slot = SLOT_BY_ID.components[piece.component_id]

        if slot then
            if blocked("components", slot, piece.drawable, piece.texture) then return slot end

            if piece.component_id == DECAL_COMPONENT
                and halfped.blockedFor(identifier, gender, piece.drawable) then
                return slot
            end
        end
    end

    local props = appearance.props or {}

    for i = 1, #props do
        local piece = props[i]
        local slot = SLOT_BY_ID.props[piece.prop_id]

        if slot and piece.drawable >= 0 and blocked("props", slot, piece.drawable, piece.texture) then
            return slot
        end
    end
end

---@param entry BlacklistRow
---@return boolean
function blacklist.save(entry)
    if entry.id then
        if type(entry.id) ~= "number" or not store:find(entry.id) then return false end

        store:update(entry.id, entry)

        return true
    end

    store:beforeInsert()

    local id = storage.save(entry)

    if not id then return false end

    entry.id = id
    store:insert(entry)

    return true
end

---@param id number
function blacklist.remove(id)
    store:remove(id)
end

---@return { added: number }
function blacklist.sync()
    local missing = pending()

    store:beforeInsert()

    for i = 1, #missing do
        local row = missing[i]
        local id = storage.save(row)

        if id then
            row.id = id
            store:insert(row)
        end
    end

    state.mark(SECTION)

    imported = true

    return { added = #missing }
end

CreateThread(reload)

return blacklist


########## FILE: \server\catalogue.lua
local RESOURCE = GetCurrentResourceName()
local FILE = "data/peds.lua"
local MAX_ENTRIES = 4096
local NAME_MAX = 64

---@type string[]
local catalogue = require "data.peds"

local pedsCatalogue = {}

---@return string[]
function pedsCatalogue.all()
    return catalogue
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
local function validModel(value)
    return type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= NAME_MAX and value:match("^[%w_]+$") ~= nil
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
local function validList(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" or #value == 0 or #value > MAX_ENTRIES then return false end

    local seen = {}

    for i = 1, #value do
        local model = value[i]

        if not validModel(model) or seen[model] then return false end

        seen[model] = true
    end

    return true
end

---@param list string[]
---@return boolean
function pedsCatalogue.save(list)
    if not validList(list) then return false end

    local lines = table.create(#list + 2, 0)

    lines[1] = "return {"

    for i = 1, #list do
        lines[i + 1] = ("    %q,"):format(list[i])
    end

    lines[#lines + 1] = "}\n"

    local written = SaveResourceFile(RESOURCE, FILE, table.concat(lines, "\n"), -1)

    if not written then return false end

    catalogue = list

    return true
end

return pedsCatalogue

########## FILE: \server\halfped.lua
local storage = require "server.storage.halfped"
local validate = require "server.validate"
local cache = require "modules.cache"
local Net = require "modules.net"
local halfpedConfig = require "config.halfped"

local GENDERS = { male = true, female = true }
local EVENT = "rhd_appearance:halfped:data"

local peds = cache.new({ update = function() end, remove = storage.remove })
local grants = cache.new({ update = function() end, remove = storage.revoke })
local loaded = false

local halfped = {}

---@return boolean
function halfped.loaded()
    return loaded
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
local function validName(value)
    return type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= 50
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
local function validExpiry(value)
    if value == nil then return true end

    return type(value) == "string" and value:match("^%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d$") ~= nil
end

local function reload()
    peds:load(storage.all())
    grants:load(storage.allAccess())
    loaded = true
end

---@return HalfPed[]
function halfped.all()
    return peds:all()
end

---@return HalfPedAccess[]
function halfped.allAccess()
    return grants:all()
end

---@param identifier string?
function halfped.dropExpired(identifier)
    if not identifier then return end

    local today = os.date("%Y-%m-%d")
    local rows = grants:all()
    local expired = {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]

        if type(row.expires) == "string" and row.expires < today and row.citizenid == identifier then
            expired[#expired + 1] = row.id
        end
    end

    for i = 1, #expired do
        grants:remove(expired[i])
    end
end

---@param identifier string?
function halfped.notifyOwner(identifier)
    if not identifier then return end

    local players = GetPlayers()

    for i = 1, #players do
        local target = tonumber(players[i])

        if target and Framework.GetIdentifier(target) == identifier then
            return halfped.publish(target)
        end
    end
end

---@param id number
---@return string? citizenid
function halfped.ownerOfAccess(id)
    local row = grants:find(id)

    return row and row.citizenid or nil
end

---@param identifier string?
---@param gender string
---@param drawable number
---@return boolean
function halfped.blockedFor(identifier, gender, drawable)
    local registered = peds:all()
    local listed = false

    for i = 1, #registered do
        local entry = registered[i]

        if entry.gender == gender and entry.drawable == drawable then
            listed = true
            break
        end
    end

    if not listed then return false end
    if not identifier then return true end

    local rows = grants:all()

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]

        if row.citizenid == identifier and row.gender == gender and row.drawable == drawable then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

---@param data any
---@return boolean
function halfped.validPed(data)
    return type(data) == "table"
        and validName(data.name)
        and GENDERS[data.gender] ~= nil
        and validate.number(data.drawable, 0, 4096)
end

---@param data any
---@return boolean
function halfped.validGrant(data)
    return type(data) == "table"
        and type(data.halfPedId) == "number"
        and validName(data.name)
        and validName(data.citizenid)
        and validExpiry(data.expires)
end

---@param data { name: string, gender: string, drawable: number }
---@return boolean
function halfped.register(data)
    peds:beforeInsert()

    local id = storage.register(data.name, data.gender, data.drawable)

    if not id then return false end

    peds:insert({ id = id, name = data.name, gender = data.gender, drawable = data.drawable })
    halfped.publishAll()

    return true
end

---@param id number
function halfped.remove(id)
    grants:forget(function(row) return row.halfPedId == id end)
    peds:remove(id)
    halfped.publishAll()
end

---@param data { halfPedId: number, name: string, citizenid: string, expires: string? }
---@return boolean
function halfped.grant(data)
    local owner = peds:find(data.halfPedId)

    if not owner then return false end

    grants:beforeInsert()

    local id = storage.grant(data.halfPedId, data.name, data.citizenid, data.expires)

    if not id then return false end

    grants:insert({
        id = id,
        halfPedId = data.halfPedId,
        name = data.name,
        citizenid = data.citizenid,
        expires = data.expires,
        gender = owner.gender,
        drawable = owner.drawable
    })

    halfped.notifyOwner(data.citizenid)

    return true
end

---@param id number
function halfped.revoke(id)
    local owner = halfped.ownerOfAccess(id)

    grants:remove(id)
    halfped.notifyOwner(owner)
end

---@param identifier string?
---@return table
local function payload(identifier)
    local blocked = { male = {}, female = {} }
    local granted = { male = {}, female = {} }
    local mine = {}

    local rows = grants:all()

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]

        if row.citizenid == identifier and granted[row.gender] then
            local list = granted[row.gender]

            list[#list + 1] = row.drawable
            mine[row.gender .. row.drawable] = true
        end
    end

    local registered = peds:all()

    for i = 1, #registered do
        local entry = registered[i]
        local list = blocked[entry.gender]

        if list and not mine[entry.gender .. entry.drawable] then
            list[#list + 1] = entry.drawable
        end
    end

    return { blocked = blocked, granted = granted, disabledFace = halfpedConfig.disabledFace }
end

---@param source number
function halfped.publish(source)
    local identifier = Framework.GetIdentifier(source)

    if not identifier then return end

    halfped.dropExpired(identifier)
    Net.emitLatentClient(EVENT, source, payload(identifier))
end

function halfped.publishAll()
    local players = GetPlayers()

    for i = 1, #players do
        local target = tonumber(players[i])

        if target then halfped.publish(target) end
    end
end

CreateThread(reload)

return halfped


########## FILE: \server\items.lua
local config = require "config.items"

---@type table<number, table<string, true>>
local worn = {}

---@type table<number, true>
local busy = {}

---@param source number
---@param name string
---@return boolean
local function owns(source, name)
    return exports.ox_inventory:GetItemCount(source, name) > 0
end

---@param source number
---@param name string
local function use(source, name)
    if busy[source] or not owns(source, name) then return end

    busy[source] = true

    local wearing = lib.callback.await("rhd_appearance:items:use", source, name)

    busy[source] = nil

    local list = worn[source]

    if not wearing then
        if list then list[name] = nil end

        return
    end

    if not list then
        list = {}
        worn[source] = list
    end

    list[name] = true
end

AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function()
    worn[source] = nil
    busy[source] = nil
end)

---@param payload table
---@return boolean
local function onSwap(payload)
    if payload.fromInventory == payload.toInventory then return true end
    if payload.fromType ~= "player" then return true end

    local list = worn[payload.fromInventory]
    local name = payload.fromSlot and payload.fromSlot.name

    if not list or not name or not list[name] then return true end

    list[name] = nil

    TriggerClientEvent("rhd_appearance:items:refuse", payload.fromInventory, name)

    return false
end

CreateThread(function()
    local filter = {}
    local any = false

    for name in pairs(config) do
        filter[name] = true
        any = true
    end

    if not any then return end

    if GetResourceState("ox_inventory") ~= "started" then
        return lib.print.warn("clothing items are configured but ox_inventory is not running")
    end

    exports.ox_inventory:registerHook("swapItems", onSwap, { print = false, itemFilter = filter })

    for name in pairs(config) do
        local registered = Framework.registerUsableItem(name, function(player)
            use(player, name)
        end)

        if registered == false then
            lib.print.warn(("'%s' cannot be used: this framework has no usable item registry"):format(name))
        end
    end
end)


########## FILE: \server\oplas.lua
local ITEM = "oplasbaru"

---@type table<number, true>
local active = {}

---@param source number
local function run(source)
    local ok, err = pcall(lib.callback.await, "rhd_appearance:oplas:open", source)

    active[source] = nil

    if not ok then
        return lib.print.warn(("'%s' use by %s failed: %s"):format(ITEM, source, err))
    end

    lib.notify(source, { description = locale("oplas.done"), type = "success" })
end

---@param source number
local function use(source)
    if active[source] then return end

    local slot = exports.ox_inventory:GetSlotWithItem(source, ITEM)

    if not slot then return end

    if not exports.ox_inventory:RemoveItem(source, ITEM, 1, nil, slot.slot) then
        return lib.print.warn(("'%s' use by %s failed: could not remove slot %s"):format(ITEM, source, slot.slot))
    end

    active[source] = true

    CreateThread(function()
        run(source)
    end)
end

AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function()
    active[source] = nil
end)

CreateThread(function()
    if GetResourceState("ox_inventory") ~= "started" then
        return lib.print.warn(("'%s' cannot be used: ox_inventory is not running"):format(ITEM))
    end

    local registered = Framework.registerUsableItem(ITEM, use)

    if registered == false then
        lib.print.warn(("'%s' cannot be used: this framework has no usable item registry"):format(ITEM))
    end
end)


########## FILE: \server\outfits.lua
local storage = require "server.storage.outfits"
local validate = require "server.validate"
local peds = require "server.peds"
local blacklist = require "server.blacklist"
local config = require "config.outfits"

local CODE_PATTERN = "...."

local outfits = {}

---@param source number
---@return string?
local function identifierOf(source)
    return Framework.GetIdentifier(source)
end

---@return string
local function uniqueCode()
    local code

    repeat
        code = lib.string.random(CODE_PATTERN, config.codeLength)
    until not storage.byCode(code)

    return code
end

---@param identifier string
---@param name string
---@param outfit table
---@return boolean
local function copyOutfit(identifier, name, outfit)
    local components = json.decode(outfit.components)
    local props = json.decode(outfit.props)

    return storage.add(identifier, name, outfit.model, components, props) ~= nil
end

function outfits.get(source)
    local identifier = identifierOf(source)

    if not identifier then return {} end

    return storage.all(identifier)
end

function outfits.save(source, name, model, components, props)
    local identifier = identifierOf(source)

    if not identifier
        or not validate.outfitName(name)
        or not validate.model(model)
        or not peds.saveable(source, model)
        or not validate.slots(components, "component_id")
        or not validate.slots(props, "prop_id")
        or blacklist.blocks(source, { model = model, components = components, props = props }) then
        return false
    end

    if storage.byName(identifier, name) then return false end

    return storage.add(identifier, name, model, components, props) ~= nil
end

function outfits.update(source, id, model, components, props)
    local identifier = identifierOf(source)

    if not identifier
        or type(id) ~= "number"
        or not validate.model(model)
        or not peds.saveable(source, model)
        or not validate.slots(components, "component_id")
        or not validate.slots(props, "prop_id")
        or blacklist.blocks(source, { model = model, components = components, props = props }) then
        return false
    end

    local outfit = storage.byId(id)

    if not outfit or outfit.citizenid ~= identifier then return false end

    storage.update(id, model, components, props)

    return true
end

function outfits.remove(source, id)
    local identifier = identifierOf(source)

    if not identifier or type(id) ~= "number" then return false end

    local outfit = storage.byId(id)

    if not outfit or outfit.citizenid ~= identifier then return false end

    storage.delete(id)

    return true
end

function outfits.generateCode(source, id)
    local identifier = identifierOf(source)

    if not identifier or type(id) ~= "number" then return end

    local outfit = storage.byId(id)

    if not outfit or outfit.citizenid ~= identifier then return end

    local existing = storage.codeOf(id)

    if existing then return existing.code end

    local code = uniqueCode()

    return storage.addCode(id, code) and code or nil
end

function outfits.import(source, name, code)
    local identifier = identifierOf(source)

    if not identifier or not validate.outfitName(name) or type(code) ~= "string" then return false end

    local entry = storage.byCode(code)

    if not entry then return false end

    local outfit = storage.byId(entry.outfitid)

    if not outfit then return false end

    if outfit.citizenid == identifier then return false end
    if storage.byName(identifier, name) then return false end

    return copyOutfit(identifier, name, outfit)
end

for name, fn in pairs(outfits) do
    lib.callback.register("rhd_appearance:outfits:" .. (name == "remove" and "delete" or name), fn)
end

return outfits


########## FILE: \server\peds.lua
local storage = require "server.storage.peds"
local state = require "server.storage.state"
local validate = require "server.validate"
local cache = require "modules.cache"
local Net = require "modules.net"
local pedConfig = require "config.peds"

local SECTION = "peds"
local EVENT = "rhd_appearance:peds:data"

local ALL = "*"

local store = cache.new({ update = storage.update, remove = storage.remove })
local imported = false
local loaded = false

local peds = {}

---@return boolean
function peds.loaded()
    return loaded
end

---@param rule table
---@return boolean
local function unconditional(rule)
    return not (rule.jobs or rule.gangs or rule.aces or rule.identifiers)
end

---@param rule table
---@param model string
---@return boolean
local function covers(rule, model)
    local list = rule.models

    if #list == 1 and list[1] == ALL then return true end

    for i = 1, #list do
        if list[i] == model then return true end
    end

    return false
end

---@param fn fun(rule: table)
local function eachRule(fn)
    if not imported then
        local groups = pedConfig.groups

        for i = 1, #groups do
            fn(groups[i])
        end
    end

    local rows = store:all()

    for i = 1, #rows do
        fn(rows[i])
    end
end

---@param rule table
---@return string
local function fingerprint(rule)
    return json.encode({
        rule.label or "",
        rule.models,
        rule.jobs or false,
        rule.gangs or false,
        rule.aces or false,
        rule.identifiers or false
    })
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
local function validModels(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" or #value == 0 or #value > 2048 then return false end

    for i = 1, #value do
        local model = value[i]

        if model ~= ALL and not validate.model(model) then return false end
    end

    return true
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
function peds.validRule(value)
    return type(value) == "table"
        and (value.label == nil or type(value.label) == "string" and #value.label <= 50)
        and validModels(value.models)
        and validate.requireJobs(value.jobs)
        and validate.requireJobs(value.gangs)
        and validate.strings(value.aces, 32)
        and validate.strings(value.identifiers, 64)
end

local function reload()
    store:load(storage.all())
    imported = state.synced()[SECTION] == true
    loaded = true
end

---@return PedGroup[]
local function pending()
    local seen = {}
    local rows = store:all()

    for i = 1, #rows do
        seen[fingerprint(rows[i])] = true
    end

    local groups = pedConfig.groups
    local missing = {}

    for i = 1, #groups do
        local group = groups[i]

        if not seen[fingerprint(group)] then
            missing[#missing + 1] = group
        end
    end

    return missing
end

---@param into table<string, true>
function peds.aceNames(into)
    eachRule(function(rule)
        local aces = rule.aces

        for i = 1, aces and #aces or 0 do
            into[aces[i]] = true
        end
    end)
end

---@return table
function peds.snapshot()
    return {
        mode = pedConfig.mode,
        rules = store:all(),
        imported = imported,
        pending = #pending()
    }
end

---@param source number
---@param rule table
---@return boolean
local function unlockedFor(source, rule)
    if rule.jobs and Framework.playerHoldsJob(source, rule.jobs) then return true end
    if rule.gangs and Framework.playerHoldsGang(source, rule.gangs) then return true end

    if rule.aces then
        for i = 1, #rule.aces do
            if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], rule.aces[i]) then return true end
        end
    end

    if rule.identifiers then
        local identifier = Framework.GetIdentifier(source)

        if identifier then
            for i = 1, #rule.identifiers do
                if rule.identifiers[i] == identifier then return true end
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

---@param source number
---@param model string
---@return boolean
function peds.saveable(source, model)
    local allow = pedConfig.mode ~= "blacklist"
    local hit = false

    eachRule(function(rule)
        if hit then return end

        local holds = unconditional(rule) or unlockedFor(source, rule)

        if holds == allow and covers(rule, model) then hit = true end
    end)

    return allow == hit
end

---@return table
local function payload()
    local rows = store:all()
    local rules = table.create(#rows, 0)

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local rule = rows[i]

        rules[i] = {
            models = rule.models,
            jobs = rule.jobs,
            gangs = rule.gangs,
            aces = rule.aces,
            identifiers = rule.identifiers
        }
    end

    return { mode = pedConfig.mode, rules = rules, imported = imported }
end

---@param source number
function peds.publish(source)
    Net.emitLatentClient(EVENT, source, payload())
end

---@param rule PedRule
---@return boolean
function peds.save(rule)
    if rule.id then
        if type(rule.id) ~= "number" or not store:find(rule.id) then return false end

        store:update(rule.id, rule)

        return true
    end

    store:beforeInsert()

    local id = storage.insert(rule)

    if not id then return false end

    rule.id = id
    store:insert(rule)

    return true
end

---@param id number
function peds.remove(id)
    store:remove(id)
end

---@return { added: number }
function peds.sync()
    local missing = pending()

    store:beforeInsert()

    for i = 1, #missing do
        local rule = missing[i]
        local id = storage.insert(rule)

        if id then
            store:insert({
                id = id,
                label = rule.label,
                models = rule.models,
                jobs = rule.jobs,
                gangs = rule.gangs,
                aces = rule.aces,
                identifiers = rule.identifiers
            })
        end
    end

    state.mark(SECTION)

    imported = true

    return { added = #missing }
end

CreateThread(reload)

return peds


########## FILE: \server\shops.lua
local config = require "config.shops"

---@param shopType string
---@return number?
local function costOf(shopType)
    local cost = config.costs[shopType]

    return cost and cost > 0 and cost or nil
end

---@param source number
---@param cost number
---@return boolean
local function take(source, cost)
    if Framework.RemoveMoney(source, config.account, cost) then
        lib.notify(source, {
            description = locale("shops.paid", cost),
            type = "success"
        })

        return true
    end

    lib.notify(source, {
        description = locale("shops.poor"),
        type = "error"
    })

    return false
end

lib.callback.register("rhd_appearance:shops:charge", function(source, shopType)
    local cost = costOf(shopType)

    if not cost then return true end

    return take(source, cost)
end)

lib.callback.register("rhd_appearance:shops:chargeTattoo", function(source)
    local cost = costOf("tattoo")

    if not cost then return true end

    return take(source, cost)
end)


########## FILE: \server\sync.lua
local blacklist = require "server.blacklist"
local peds = require "server.peds"
local halfped = require "server.halfped"
local events = require "modules.events"

local sync = {}

local function ready()
    while not (blacklist.loaded() and peds.loaded() and halfped.loaded()) do
        Wait(50)
    end
end

---@param source number
function sync.push(source)
    CreateThread(function()
        ready()

        blacklist.publish(source)
        peds.publish(source)
        halfped.publish(source)
    end)
end

function sync.pushAll()
    local players = GetPlayers()

    for i = 1, #players do
        local target = tonumber(players[i])

        if target then sync.push(target) end
    end
end

events.on("playerLoaded", sync.push)

CreateThread(function()
    ready()
    sync.pushAll()
end)

return sync


########## FILE: \server\validate.lua
local pedModels = require "data.peds"
local constants = require "data.constants"
local shared = require "config.general"
local items = require "modules.items"

local NAME_MAX = 50

local GENDER_BY_MODEL = {
    [shared.freemodeModels.male] = "male",
    [shared.freemodeModels.female] = "female"
}

local SLOT_BY_ID = { components = {}, props = {} }

for name, slot in pairs(constants.SLOTS) do
    SLOT_BY_ID[slot.category][slot.id] = name
end

---@type table<string, true>?
local knownModels

local validate = {}

---@param model any
---@return boolean
function validate.model(model)
    if type(model) ~= "string" then return false end

    if not knownModels then
        knownModels = table.create(0, #pedModels)

        for i = 1, #pedModels do
            knownModels[pedModels[i]] = true
        end
    end

    return knownModels[model] == true
end

---@param value any
---@param min number
---@param max number
---@return boolean
function validate.number(value, min, max)
    return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= min and value <= max
end

---@param name any
---@return boolean
function validate.outfitName(name)
    return type(name) == "string" and #name > 0 and #name <= NAME_MAX
end

---@param value any
---@param limit number?
---@return boolean
function validate.name(value, limit)
    return type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= (limit or NAME_MAX)
end

---@param value any
---@param limit number
---@return boolean
function validate.strings(value, limit)
    if value == nil then return true end
    if type(value) ~= "table" or #value > limit then return false end

    for i = 1, #value do
        if not validate.name(value[i]) then return false end
    end

    return true
end

---@param value any
---@return boolean
function validate.requireJobs(value)
    if value == nil then return true end
    if validate.name(value) then return true end
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end

    local count = 0

    for key, entry in pairs(value) do
        count += 1

        if count > 32 then return false end

        if type(key) == "number" then
            if not validate.name(entry) then return false end
        elseif not validate.name(key) then
            return false
        elseif type(entry) == "number" then
            if not validate.number(entry, 0, 100) then return false end
        elseif type(entry) == "table" then
            if #entry == 0 or #entry > 32 then return false end

            for i = 1, #entry do
                if not validate.number(entry[i], 0, 100) then return false end
            end
        else
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

---@param list any
---@param key string
---@return boolean
function validate.slots(list, key)
    if type(list) ~= "table" then return false end

    local bounds = constants.RANGES.slot

    for i = 1, #list do
        local slot = list[i]

        if type(slot) ~= "table"
            or not validate.number(slot[key], bounds.id.min, bounds.id.max)
            or not validate.number(slot.drawable, bounds.drawable.min, bounds.drawable.max)
            or not validate.number(slot.texture, bounds.texture.min, bounds.texture.max) then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

---@param appearance table
---@return boolean
local function freeOfItems(appearance)
    local gender = GENDER_BY_MODEL[appearance.model]

    if not gender then return true end

    local components = appearance.components

    for i = 1, #components do
        local piece = components[i]
        local slot = SLOT_BY_ID.components[piece.component_id]

        if slot and items.blocks(gender, slot, piece.drawable, piece.texture) then return false end
    end

    local props = appearance.props

    for i = 1, #props do
        local piece = props[i]
        local slot = SLOT_BY_ID.props[piece.prop_id]

        if slot and items.blocks(gender, slot, piece.drawable, piece.texture) then return false end
    end

    return true
end

---@param appearance any
---@return boolean
function validate.appearance(appearance)
    if type(appearance) ~= "table" then return false end
    if not validate.model(appearance.model) then return false end
    if not validate.slots(appearance.components, "component_id") then return false end
    if not validate.slots(appearance.props, "prop_id") then return false end

    return freeOfItems(appearance)
end

return validate


########## FILE: \server\storage\blacklist.lua
local db = exports.oxmysql
local config = require "config.general"

local SCHEMA = [[
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `appearance_blacklist` (
    `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `gender` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    `category` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    `slot` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    `drawable` int(11) NOT NULL,
    `textures` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
    `jobs` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
    `gangs` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
    `aces` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
    `citizenids` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    UNIQUE KEY `gender_category_slot_drawable` (`gender`,`category`,`slot`,`drawable`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
]]

local blacklist = {}

if config.autoCreateTables then
    CreateThread(function()
        db:query_async(SCHEMA)
    end)
end

---@param value string?
---@return any?
local function decode(value)
    if not value then return nil end

    local result = json.decode(value)

    if type(result) == "table" and next(result) == nil then return nil end

    return result
end

---@param value any?
---@return string?
local function encode(value)
    if value == nil then return nil end
    if type(value) == "table" and next(value) == nil then return nil end

    return json.encode(value)
end

---@return BlacklistRow[]
function blacklist.all()
    local rows = db:query_async(
        "SELECT id, gender, category, slot, drawable, textures, jobs, gangs, aces, citizenids FROM appearance_blacklist"
    ) or {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]

        row.textures = decode(row.textures)
        row.jobs = decode(row.jobs)
        row.gangs = decode(row.gangs)
        row.aces = decode(row.aces)
        row.citizenids = decode(row.citizenids)
    end

    return rows
end

---@param entry BlacklistRow
---@return number? id
function blacklist.save(entry)
    return db:insert_async([[
        INSERT INTO appearance_blacklist (gender, category, slot, drawable, textures, jobs, gangs, aces, citizenids)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
            id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id),
            textures = VALUES(textures),
            jobs = VALUES(jobs),
            gangs = VALUES(gangs),
            aces = VALUES(aces),
            citizenids = VALUES(citizenids)
    ]], {
        entry.gender,
        entry.category,
        entry.slot,
        entry.drawable,
        encode(entry.textures),
        encode(entry.jobs),
        encode(entry.gangs),
        encode(entry.aces),
        encode(entry.citizenids)
    })
end

---@param id number
---@param entry BlacklistRow
function blacklist.update(id, entry)
    db:update_async([[
        UPDATE appearance_blacklist
        SET gender = ?, category = ?, slot = ?, drawable = ?, textures = ?, jobs = ?, gangs = ?,
            aces = ?, citizenids = ?
        WHERE id = ?
    ]], {
        entry.gender,
        entry.category,
        entry.slot,
        entry.drawable,
        encode(entry.textures),
        encode(entry.jobs),
        encode(entry.gangs),
        encode(entry.aces),
        encode(entry.citizenids),
        id
    })
end

---@param id number
function blacklist.remove(id)
    db:update_async("DELETE FROM appearance_blacklist WHERE id = ?", { id })
end

return blacklist

local db = exports.oxmysql
local config = require "config.general"

local SCHEMA = {
    [[

        `drawable` int(11) NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
        UNIQUE KEY `gender_drawable` (`gender`,`drawable`)
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
    ]],
    [[
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `appearance_half_ped_access` (
        `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
        `half_ped_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
        `name` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
        `citizenid` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
        `expires_at` date DEFAULT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
        UNIQUE KEY `half_ped_citizenid` (`half_ped_id`,`citizenid`),
        KEY `citizenid` (`citizenid`)
    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
    ]]
}

local halfped = {}

if config.autoCreateTables then
    CreateThread(function()
        for i = 1, #SCHEMA do
            db:query_async(SCHEMA[i])
        end
    end)
end

---@return HalfPed[]
function halfped.all()
    local rows = db:query_async("SELECT id, name, gender, drawable FROM appearance_half_peds") or {}

    return rows
end

---@param name string
---@param gender string
---@param drawable number
---@return number? id
function halfped.register(name, gender, drawable)
    return db:insert_async(
        "INSERT INTO appearance_half_peds (name, gender, drawable) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", {
            name, gender, drawable
        })
end

---@param id number
function halfped.remove(id)
    db:transaction_async({
        { query = "DELETE FROM appearance_half_ped_access WHERE half_ped_id = ?", values = { id } },
        { query = "DELETE FROM appearance_half_peds WHERE id = ?", values = { id } }
    })
end

---@return HalfPedAccess[]
function halfped.allAccess()
    return db:query_async([[
        SELECT a.id, a.half_ped_id AS halfPedId, a.name, a.citizenid,
               DATE_FORMAT(a.expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expires,
               p.gender, p.drawable
        FROM appearance_half_ped_access a
        JOIN appearance_half_peds p ON p.id = a.half_ped_id
    ]]) or {}
end

---@param halfPedId number
---@param name string
---@param identifier string
---@param expires string?
---@return number? id
function halfped.grant(halfPedId, name, identifier, expires)
    return db:insert_async([[
        INSERT INTO appearance_half_ped_access (half_ped_id, name, citizenid, expires_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), name = VALUES(name), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at)
    ]], { halfPedId, name, identifier, expires })
end

---@param id number
function halfped.revoke(id)
    db:query_async("DELETE FROM appearance_half_ped_access WHERE id = ?", { id })
end

return halfped


########## FILE: \server\storage\main.lua
local db = exports.oxmysql
local config = require "config.general"

local SCHEMA = [[
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `playerskins` (
    `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `citizenid` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    `model` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    `skin` text NOT NULL,
    `active` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    KEY `citizenid` (`citizenid`),
    KEY `active` (`active`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
]]

local storage = {}

if config.autoCreateTables then
    CreateThread(function()
        db:query_async(SCHEMA)
    end)
end

---@param identifier string
---@param model string?
---@return PedAppearance?
function storage.getClothing(identifier, model)
    local skin

    if model then
        skin = db:scalar_async("SELECT skin FROM playerskins WHERE citizenid = ? AND model = ?", {
            identifier, model
        })
    else
        skin = db:scalar_async("SELECT skin FROM playerskins WHERE citizenid = ? AND active = 1", {
            identifier
        })
    end

    if not skin then return end

    local ok, appearance = pcall(json.decode, skin)

    return ok and appearance or nil
end

---@param identifier string
---@param appearance PedAppearance
---@return boolean
function storage.saveClothing(identifier, appearance)
    local model = appearance.model

    return db:transaction_async({
        {
            query = "UPDATE playerskins SET active = 0 WHERE citizenid = ?",
            values = { identifier }
        },
        {
            query = "DELETE FROM playerskins WHERE citizenid = ? AND model = ?",
            values = { identifier, model }
        },
        {
            query = "INSERT INTO playerskins (citizenid, model, skin, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)",
            values = { identifier, model, json.encode(appearance) }
        }
    })
end

---@param identifier string
function storage.deleteClothing(identifier)
    db:query_async("DELETE FROM playerskins WHERE citizenid = ?", { identifier })
end

return storage

    ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

local outfits = {}

if config.autoCreateTables then
    CreateThread(function()
        for i = 1, #SCHEMA do
            db:query_async(SCHEMA[i])
        end
    end)
end

---@param identifier string
---@return Outfit[]
function outfits.all(identifier)
    local rows = db:query_async("SELECT * FROM player_outfits WHERE citizenid = ?", { identifier }) or {}
    local list = table.create(#rows, 0)

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]

        list[i] = {
            id = row.id,
            name = row.outfitname,
            model = row.model,
            components = json.decode(row.components),
            props = json.decode(row.props)
        }
    end

    return list
end

---@param id number
---@return table?
function outfits.byId(id)
    return db:single_async("SELECT * FROM player_outfits WHERE id = ?", { id })
end

---@param identifier string
---@param name string
---@return table?
function outfits.byName(identifier, name)
    return db:single_async("SELECT * FROM player_outfits WHERE outfitname = ? AND citizenid = ?", {
        name, identifier
    })
end

---@param identifier string
---@param name string
---@param model string
---@param components PedComponent[]
---@param props PedProp[]
---@return number? id
function outfits.add(identifier, name, model, components, props)
    return db:insert_async(
        "INSERT INTO player_outfits (citizenid, outfitname, model, components, props) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", {
            identifier, name, model, json.encode(components), json.encode(props)
        })
end

---@param id number
---@param model string
---@param components PedComponent[]
---@param props PedProp[]
function outfits.update(id, model, components, props)
    db:update_async("UPDATE player_outfits SET model = ?, components = ?, props = ? WHERE id = ?", {
        model, json.encode(components), json.encode(props), id
    })
end

---@param id number
function outfits.delete(id)
    db:transaction_async({
        { query = "DELETE FROM player_outfit_codes WHERE outfitid = ?", values = { id } },
        { query = "DELETE FROM player_outfits WHERE id = ?", values = { id } }
    })
end

---@param code string
---@return table?
function outfits.byCode(code)
    return db:single_async("SELECT * FROM player_outfit_codes WHERE code = ?", { code })
end

---@param id number
---@return table?
function outfits.codeOf(id)
    return db:single_async("SELECT * FROM player_outfit_codes WHERE outfitid = ?", { id })
end

---@param id number
---@param code string
---@return number?
function outfits.addCode(id, code)
    return db:insert_async("INSERT INTO player_outfit_codes (outfitid, code) VALUES (?, ?)", { id, code })
end

return outfits


########## FILE: \server\storage\peds.lua
local db = exports.oxmysql
local config = require "config.general"

local SCHEMA = [[
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `appearance_ped_access` (
    `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `label` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    `models` text NOT NULL,
    `jobs` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
    `gangs` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
    `aces` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
    `citizenids` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
]]

local peds = {}

if config.autoCreateTables then
    CreateThread(function()
        db:query_async(SCHEMA)
    end)
end

---@param value string?
---@return any?
local function decode(value)
    if not value then return nil end

    local result = json.decode(value)

    if type(result) == "table" and next(result) == nil then return nil end

    return result
end

---@param value any?
---@return string?
local function encode(value)
    if value == nil then return nil end
    if type(value) == "table" and next(value) == nil then return nil end

    return json.encode(value)
end

---@return PedRule[]
function peds.all()
    local rows = db:query_async(
        "SELECT id, label, models, jobs, gangs, aces, citizenids FROM appearance_ped_access") or {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]

        row.models = decode(row.models) or {}
        row.jobs = decode(row.jobs)
        row.gangs = decode(row.gangs)
        row.aces = decode(row.aces)
        row.identifiers = decode(row.citizenids)
        row.citizenids = nil
    end

    return rows
end

---@param rule table
---@return number? id
function peds.insert(rule)
    return db:insert_async([[
        INSERT INTO appearance_ped_access (label, models, jobs, gangs, aces, citizenids)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ]], {
        rule.label or "",
        json.encode(rule.models),
        encode(rule.jobs),
        encode(rule.gangs),
        encode(rule.aces),
        encode(rule.identifiers)
    })
end

---@param id number
---@param rule table
---@return boolean
function peds.update(id, rule)
    local affected = db:update_async([[
        UPDATE appearance_ped_access
        SET label = ?, models = ?, jobs = ?, gangs = ?, aces = ?, citizenids = ?
        WHERE id = ?
    ]], {
        rule.label or "",
        json.encode(rule.models),
        encode(rule.jobs),
        encode(rule.gangs),
        encode(rule.aces),
        encode(rule.identifiers),
        id
    })

    return affected ~= nil
end

---@param id number
function peds.remove(id)
    db:update_async("DELETE FROM appearance_ped_access WHERE id = ?", { id })
end

return peds


########## FILE: \server\storage\state.lua
local db = exports.oxmysql
local config = require "config.general"

local SCHEMA = [[
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `appearance_config_state` (
    `section` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
    `synced_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (`section`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
]]

local state = {}

if config.autoCreateTables then
    CreateThread(function()
        db:query_async(SCHEMA)
    end)
end

---@return table<string, true>
function state.synced()
    local rows = db:query_async("SELECT section FROM appearance_config_state") or {}
    local result = {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        result[rows[i].section] = true
    end

    return result
end

---@param section string
function state.mark(section)
    db:update_async(
        "INSERT INTO appearance_config_state (section) VALUES (?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP",
        { section })
end

---@param section string
function state.clear(section)
    db:update_async("DELETE FROM appearance_config_state WHERE section = ?", { section })
end

return state

---@param origin vector3
---@param heading number
---@param point vector3
---@return vector3
local function toLocal(origin, heading, point)
    local rad = math.rad(heading)
    local dx, dy = point.x - origin.x, point.y - origin.y

    return vec3(dx * math.cos(rad) + dy * math.sin(rad), -dx * math.sin(rad) + dy * math.cos(rad), point.z - origin.z)
end

---@param value vector3
---@return string
local function vec(value)
    return ('vec3(%.2f, %.2f, %.2f)'):format(value.x, value.y, value.z)
end

---@param view { config: table, anchor: vector3, heading: number, label: string }
---@param position vector3
---@param focus vector3
---@param fov number
local function save(view, position, focus, fov)
    local localPosition = toLocal(view.anchor, view.heading, position)
    local localFocus = toLocal(view.anchor, view.heading, focus)
    local line = ('%s = { position = %s, focus = %s, fov = %.1f },'):format(view.label, vec(localPosition), vec(localFocus), fov)

    view.config.position = localPosition
    view.config.focus = localFocus
    view.config.fov = fov

    lib.setClipboard(line)
    print(('[sm_characters] kamera: %s'):format(line))
    lib.notify({ description = 'Nilai kamera disalin ke clipboard dan F8, dipakai sampai resource restart.', type = 'success' })
end

RegisterCommand('smchar_cam', function()
    if freecam then
        freecam = false
        return
    end

    local view = select.view()
    local base = camera.handle()

    if not view or not base then
        return lib.notify({ description = 'Buka layar pilih karakter dulu.', type = 'error' })
    end

    freecam = true

    local position = GetCamCoord(base)
    local rotation = GetCamRot(base, 2)
    local fov = GetCamFov(base)
    local pitch, yaw = rotation.x, rotation.z
    local cam = CreateCamWithParams('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', position.x, position.y, position.z, pitch, 0.0, yaw, fov, true, 2)

    nui.focus(false)
    RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, false)
    lib.notify({
        description = 'Free-cam: mouse untuk melihat, WASD/Q/E gerak, Shift cepat, scroll FOV, Enter simpan, Backspace keluar.',
        type = 'inform',
        duration = 8000,
    })

    CreateThread(function()
        while freecam do
            DisableAllControlActions(0)

            yaw -= GetDisabledControlNormal(0, 1) * 6.0
            pitch = math.max(-89.0, math.min(89.0, pitch - GetDisabledControlNormal(0, 2) * 6.0))

            local rx, rz = math.rad(pitch), math.rad(yaw)
            local forward = vec3(-math.sin(rz) * math.cos(rx), math.cos(rz) * math.cos(rx), math.sin(rx))
            local right = vec3(math.cos(rz), math.sin(rz), 0.0)
            local speed = (IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 21) and 3.0 or 0.75) * GetFrameTime()

            if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 32) then position += forward * speed end
            if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 33) then position -= forward * speed end
            if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 35) then position += right * speed end
            if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 34) then position -= right * speed end
            if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 38) then position += vec3(0.0, 0.0, speed) end
            if IsDisabledControlPressed(0, 44) then position -= vec3(0.0, 0.0, speed) end
            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 241) then fov = math.max(10.0, fov - 2.0) end
            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 242) then fov = math.min(90.0, fov + 2.0) end

            SetCamCoord(cam, position.x, position.y, position.z)
            SetCamRot(cam, pitch, 0.0, yaw, 2)
            SetCamFov(cam, fov)

            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 191) then
                save(view, position, position + forward * 2.0, fov)
            end

            if IsDisabledControlJustPressed(0, 194) then
                freecam = false
            end

            Wait(0)
        end

        SetCamActive(cam, false)
        DestroyCam(cam, false)

        if DoesCamExist(base) then
            SetCamActive(base, true)
        end

        RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, false)

        if select.isActive() then
            nui.focus(true)
        end
    end)
end, false)

local config = require 'config.client'

---@type { done: boolean, payload: table|false }?
local background

local function guard()
    CreateThread(function()
        while NetworkIsInTutorialSession() do
            HideHudAndRadarThisFrame()
            SetEntityInvincible(cache.ped, true)
            SetPedDensityMultiplierThisFrame(0.0)
            SetScenarioPedDensityMultiplierThisFrame(0.0, 0.0)
            SetVehicleDensityMultiplierThisFrame(0.0)
            SetRandomVehicleDensityMultiplierThisFrame(0.0)
            SetParkedVehicleDensityMultiplierThisFrame(0.0)
            Wait(0)
        end

        SetEntityInvincible(cache.ped, false)
    end)
end

local function enterSession()
    NetworkStartSoloTutorialSession()

    pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
        return NetworkIsInTutorialSession() or nil
    end, nil, 10000)

    local ped = cache.ped

    SetEntityVisible(ped, false, false)
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
    DisplayRadar(false)
    config.hud.hide()
    guard()
end

local function prefetch()
    ---@type { done: boolean, payload: table|false }
    local job = { done = false, payload = false }

    background = job

    CreateThread(function()
        local ok, payload = pcall(select.load)

        if not ok then
            lib.print.error(('gagal mengambil data karakter: %s'):format(payload))
        end

        job.payload = ok and payload or false
        job.done = true
    end)
end

---@return table|false
local function fetch()
    local job = background

    background = nil

    if job then
        pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
            return job.done or nil
        end, nil, false)

        if job.payload then return job.payload end
    end

    return select.load()
end

---@return boolean
local function open()
    local began = GetGameTimer()
    local payload = fetch()
    if not payload then return false end

    local view = select.prepare(payload)

    intro.stop()
    nui.send('loading', { visible = false })
    select.show(view)
    lib.print.info(('memuat karakter: total %d ms'):format(GetGameTimer() - began))

    return true
end

---@return boolean
local function load()
    if loading then return false end

    loading = true
    nui.send('loading', { visible = true })
    utils.fadeOut(400)
    intro.hold()

    local ok, result = pcall(open)

    loading = false

    if ok and result then return true end

    if not ok then
        lib.print.error(('gagal memuat pemilihan karakter: %s'):format(result))
    end

    if select.isActive() then
        select.close()
    end

    nui.send('loading', { visible = false, error = true })
    intro.resume()

    return false
end

local function endPreview()
    local ped = PlayerPedId()

    utils.fadeOut(400)
    intro.stop()
    RenderScriptCams(false, false, 0, true, false)
    world.unlock()
    FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
    SetEntityInvincible(ped, false)
    nui.focus(false)
    config.hud.show()
    previewing = false
    utils.fadeIn(800)
end

    nuiReady = true
    cb(1)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('start', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)

    if previewing then
        return endPreview()
    end

    load()
end)

########## FILE: \client\intro.lua
local config = require 'config.client'.intro
local world = require 'modules.client.world'
local nui = require 'modules.client.nui'

local FADE_WAIT <const> = 3000

local intro = {}
local running = false
local flying = false
local alive = false
local focused = false
local session = 0
local generation = 0

local function fly()
    generation += 1
    flying = true
    alive = true

    local mine = generation

    local function live()
        return flying and mine == generation
    end

    CreateThread(function()
        local index = 1
        local shots = config.shots

        while live() do
            local shot = shots[index]
            local cam = CreateCamWithParams('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', shot.from.x, shot.from.y, shot.from.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, shot.fov, true, 2)

            PointCamAtCoord(cam, shot.target.x, shot.target.y, shot.target.z)
            RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, false)

            if focused then
                SetFocusPosAndVel(shot.from.x, shot.from.y, shot.from.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
            end

            Wait(500)

            if live() then
                DoScreenFadeIn(1500)
            end

            local began = GetGameTimer()
            local nextFocus = 0
            local fading = false

            while live() do
                local now = GetGameTimer()
                local elapsed = now - began

                if elapsed >= shot.duration then break end

                local position = shot.from + (shot.to - shot.from) * (elapsed / shot.duration)

                SetCamCoord(cam, position.x, position.y, position.z)
                PointCamAtCoord(cam, shot.target.x, shot.target.y, shot.target.z)

                if focused and now >= nextFocus then
                    SetFocusPosAndVel(position.x, position.y, position.z, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                    nextFocus = now + 250
                end

                if not fading and #shots > 1 and elapsed >= shot.duration - 1500 then
                    DoScreenFadeOut(1500)
                    fading = true
                end

                Wait(0)
            end

            if fading and live() then
                local deadline = GetGameTimer() + FADE_WAIT

                while live() and not IsScreenFadedOut() and GetGameTimer() < deadline do
                    Wait(0)
                end
            end

            DestroyCam(cam, false)
            index = index % #shots + 1
        end

        if mine ~= generation then return end

        if focused then
            ClearFocus()
        end

        alive = false
    end)
end

function intro.start()
    if running then return end

    running = true
    focused = true
    session += 1
    world.lock(config.hour, config.minute, config.weather)

    local current = session

    SetTimeout(config.uiDelay, function()
        if not running or session ~= current then return end

        nui.send('intro', { visible = true, store = config.store, credits = config.credits })
        nui.focus(true)
    end)

    fly()
end

function intro.releaseFocus()
    if not focused then return end

    focused = false
    ClearFocus()
end

function intro.hold()
    if not flying then return end

    flying = false
    intro.releaseFocus()

    pcall(lib.waitFor, function()
        return not alive or nil
    end, nil, FADE_WAIT)
end

function intro.resume()
    if not running then return intro.start() end
    if flying then return end

    focused = true
    world.lock(config.hour, config.minute, config.weather)
    fly()
end

function intro.stop()
    running = false
    nui.send('intro', { visible = false })
    intro.hold()
end

return intro

---@param ax number

local function cross2(ax, ay, bx, by)
    return ax * by - ay * bx

---@param a vector3
