-- sm_character/server/init.lua
-- Direkonstruksi mengikuti kontrak client/*.lua dan modul sm_core.
-- Tabel: players (PK citizenid), playerskins, character_partners, character_invites.

local QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()

local DEFAULT_SLOTS = 4
local INVITE_TTL    = 60
local DEFAULT_SPAWN = { x = -1042.57, y = -2745.72, z = 21.36, w = 330.0 }

local SlotOverrides = {
    -- ['license:xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx'] = 8,
}

local function getSlots(license)
    local override = SlotOverrides[license]
    if override then return override end
    local convar = tonumber(GetConvar('sm_characters_slots', ''))
    return math.max(1, convar or DEFAULT_SLOTS)
end

local function notify(src, message, kind)
    TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:notify', src, message, kind or 'error')
end

local function decode(value)
    if type(value) == 'table' then return value end
    if type(value) ~= 'string' or value == '' then return {} end
    local ok, result = pcall(json.decode, value)
    if ok and type(result) == 'table' then return result end
    return {}
end

local function getLicense(src)
    return QBCore.Functions.GetIdentifier(src, 'license') or GetPlayerIdentifierByType(src, 'license')
end

local function fullName(charinfo)
    if not charinfo then return 'Warga' end
    return ('%s %s'):format(charinfo.firstname or '', charinfo.lastname or ''):gsub('^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1')
end

local function generatePhone()
    for _ = 1, 25 do
        local phone = ('%03d%04d'):format(math.random(100, 999), math.random(0, 9999))
        local taken = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT citizenid FROM players WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(charinfo, "$.phone")) = ?', { phone })
        if not taken then return phone end
    end
    return ('%03d%04d'):format(math.random(100, 999), math.random(0, 9999))
end

local function locationById(id)
    local shared = QBCore.Shared and QBCore.Shared.Locations
    if shared and id and shared[id] then return shared[id] end
    return DEFAULT_SPAWN
end

-- Tabel pendamping partner. Dibuat sendiri supaya tidak bergantung pada migrasi.
CreateThread(function()
    MySQL.query.await([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `character_partners` (
            `citizenid` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            `partner`   VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            `since`     INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            PRIMARY KEY (`citizenid`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    ]])
    MySQL.query.await([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `character_invites` (
            `citizenid` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            `target`    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            `expires`   BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            PRIMARY KEY (`citizenid`, `target`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    ]])
    MySQL.query.await('ALTER TABLE `character_partners` CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci')
    MySQL.query.await('ALTER TABLE `character_invites` CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci')

    MySQL.query.await([[
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `playerskins` (
            `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
            `citizenid` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
            `model` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
            `skin` text NOT NULL,
            `active` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
            KEY `citizenid` (`citizenid`),
            KEY `active` (`active`)
        ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
    ]])
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fetch daftar karakter
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function buildInvites(ids, byCitizen)
    local incoming, outgoing = {}, {}

    if #ids == 0 then return incoming, outgoing end

    local placeholders = {}
    for i = 1, #ids do placeholders[i] = '?' end
    placeholders = table.concat(placeholders, ',')

    local params = {}
    for i = 1, #ids do params[#params + 1] = ids[i] end
    for i = 1, #ids do params[#params + 1] = ids[i] end
    params[#params + 1] = os.time()

    local rows = MySQL.query.await(([[
        SELECT i.citizenid, i.target, i.expires,
               p1.charinfo AS frominfo, p2.charinfo AS toinfo
        FROM character_invites i
        LEFT JOIN players p1 ON p1.citizenid = i.citizenid
        LEFT JOIN players p2 ON p2.citizenid = i.target
        WHERE (i.citizenid IN (%s) OR i.target IN (%s)) AND i.expires > ?
    ]]):format(placeholders, placeholders), params) or {}

    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        local mine = byCitizen[row.target]
        local theirs = byCitizen[row.citizenid]

        if mine then
            incoming[#incoming + 1] = {
                citizenid = row.citizenid,
                name = fullName(decode(row.frominfo)),
                expires = tonumber(row.expires) or 0,
            }
        end

        if theirs then
            outgoing[#outgoing + 1] = {
                citizenid = row.target,
                name = fullName(decode(row.toinfo)),
                expires = tonumber(row.expires) or 0,
            }
        end
    end

    return incoming, outgoing
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_characters:server:fetch', function()
    local src = source
    local license = getLicense(src)

    local payload = { characters = {}, incoming = {}, outgoing = {}, slots = 0, canDelete = false }

    if not license then
        TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:characters', src, payload)
        TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:skins', src, {})
        return
    end

    local slots = getSlots(license)
    local rows = MySQL.query.await('SELECT * FROM players WHERE license = ? ORDER BY id ASC', { license }) or {}

    local characters, ids, byCitizen = {}, {}, {}

    for i = 1, #rows do
        local row = rows[i]
        local entry = {}

        for key, value in pairs(row) do entry[key] = value end

        entry.charinfo = decode(row.charinfo)
        entry.money    = decode(row.money)
        entry.job      = decode(row.job)
        entry.gang     = decode(row.gang)
        entry.position = decode(row.position)
        entry.metadata = decode(row.metadata)

        entry.firstname   = entry.charinfo.firstname
        entry.lastname    = entry.charinfo.lastname
        entry.gender      = entry.charinfo.gender
        entry.birthdate   = entry.charinfo.birthdate
        entry.phone       = entry.charinfo.phone
        entry.nationality = entry.charinfo.nationality

        characters[#characters + 1] = entry
        ids[#ids + 1] = row.citizenid
        byCitizen[row.citizenid] = true
    end

    local skins = {}

    if #ids > 0 then
        local placeholders = {}
        for i = 1, #ids do placeholders[i] = '?' end

        local skinOk, skinRows = pcall(function()
            return MySQL.query.await(
                ('SELECT citizenid, skin FROM playerskins WHERE active = 1 AND citizenid IN (%s)'):format(table.concat(placeholders, ',')), ids) or {}
        end)
        if not skinOk then skinRows = {} end

        for _, row in ipairs(skinRows) do
            local skin = row.skin or row.appearance
            if not skin and row.model then skin = json.encode({ model = row.model }) end
            if skin then skins[row.citizenid] = skin end
        end
    end

    local incoming, outgoing = buildInvites(ids, byCitizen)

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE expires < ?', { os.time() })

    payload.characters = characters
    payload.incoming = incoming
    payload.outgoing = outgoing
    payload.slots = slots
    payload.canDelete = #characters > 1

    TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:skins', src, skins)
    TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:characters', src, payload)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Buat karakter
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function sanitizeName(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    value = value:gsub('^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1')
    if #value < 2 or #value > 20 then return nil end
    if not value:match('^[%a][%a%s%-]*$') then return nil end
    return value
end

local MONTHS = {
    januari = 1, februari = 2, maret = 3, april = 4, mei = 5, juni = 6, juli = 7,
    agustus = 8, september = 9, oktober = 10, november = 11, desember = 12,
    jan = 1, feb = 2, mar = 3, apr = 4, jun = 6, jul = 7, agu = 8, ags = 8, sep = 9, okt = 10, nov = 11, des = 12,
    january = 1, february = 2, march = 3, may = 5, june = 6, july = 7, august = 8, october = 10, december = 12,
}

local function sanitizeBirthdate(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    value = value:gsub('^%s*(.-)%s*$', '%1')

    local y, m, d
    local a, b, c = value:match('^(%d%d%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-(%d%d)$')

    if a then
        y, m, d = tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c)
    else
        local day, mon, year = value:match('^(%d%d?)%s+([%a]+)%s+(%d%d%d%d)$')
        if not day then return nil end
        m = MONTHS[mon:lower()]
        if not m then return nil end
        y, d = tonumber(year), tonumber(day)
    end

    if not y or y < 1900 or y > 2015 then return nil end
    if m < 1 or m > 12 then return nil end
    if not d or d < 1 or d > 31 then return nil end

    return ('%04d-%02d-%02d'):format(y, m, d)
end

local function sanitizeGender(value)
    if value == true or value == 1 or value == 'male' or value == 'm' or value == 'M' then return 'male' end
    if value == false or value == 0 or value == 'female' or value == 'f' or value == 'F' then return 'female' end
    return nil
end

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:create', function(source, ...)
    local args = { ... }
    local input = type(args[1]) == 'table' and args[1] or {
        firstname   = args[1],
        lastname    = args[2],
        gender      = args[3],
        birthdate   = args[4],
        nationality = args[5],
    }

    local license = getLicense(source)
    if not license then return false, 'Lisensi tidak terbaca' end

    local firstname = sanitizeName(input.firstname)
    local lastname  = sanitizeName(input.lastname)

    if not firstname then return false, 'Nama depan tidak valid (2-20 huruf)' end
    if not lastname then return false, 'Nama belakang tidak valid (2-20 huruf)' end

    local gender = sanitizeGender(input.gender)
    if not gender then return false, 'Jenis kelamin tidak valid' end

    local birthdate = sanitizeBirthdate(input.birthdate)
    if not birthdate then return false, 'Tanggal lahir harus YYYY-MM-DD' end

    local slots = getSlots(license)
    local count = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE license = ?', { license }) or 0
    if count >= slots then return false, ('Slot karakter penuh (%d/%d)'):format(count, slots) end

    local citizenid = QBCore.Player.CreateCitizenId()
    local spawn = DEFAULT_SPAWN
    local nationality = type(input.nationality) == 'string' and input.nationality:sub(1, 32) or 'Indonesia'

    local charinfo = {
        firstname = firstname,
        lastname = lastname,
        birthdate = birthdate,
        gender = gender,
        nationality = nationality,
        cid = math.random(10000, 99999),
        phone = generatePhone(),
    }

    local money = { cash = 500, bank = 5000, crypto = 0 }
    local job = { name = 'unemployed', label = 'Pengangguran', payment = 10, onduty = true, isboss = false, grade = { name = 'Freelancer', level = 0 } }
    local gang = { name = 'none', label = 'Tidak ada', grade = { name = 'Tidak ada', level = 0 } }
    local metadata = { callsign = 'NO CALLSIGN', licences = {} }

    local nextId = (MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM players') or 1)

    local params = {
        nextId,
        citizenid,
        charinfo.cid,
        license,
        ('%s %s'):format(firstname, lastname),
        json.encode(money),
        json.encode(charinfo),
        json.encode(job),
        json.encode(gang),
        json.encode(spawn),
        json.encode(metadata),
    }

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        MySQL.insert.await([[
            INSERT INTO players (id, citizenid, cid, license, name, money, charinfo, job, gang, position, metadata)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ]], params)
    end)

    if not ok then
        -- Skema tanpa kolom cid/name.
        ok, err = pcall(function()
            MySQL.insert.await([[
                INSERT INTO players (id, citizenid, license, money, charinfo, job, gang, position, metadata)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ]], { nextId, citizenid, license, params[6], params[7], params[8], params[9], params[10], params[11] })
        end)
    end

    if not ok then
        lib.print.error(('gagal membuat karakter: %s'):format(err))
        return false, 'Gagal menyimpan karakter'
    end

    return { coords = vec4(spawn.x, spawn.y, spawn.z, spawn.w), citizenid = citizenid }
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:select', function(source, citizenid)
    local license = getLicense(source)
    if not license then return false, 'Lisensi tidak terbaca' end

    if QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source) then
        return false, 'Karakter sudah dimuat'
    end

    local owner = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT license FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
    if not owner then return false, 'Karakter tidak ditemukan' end
    if owner ~= license then return false, 'Karakter bukan milik Anda' end

    local ok, result = pcall(QBCore.Player.Login, source, citizenid)
    if not ok then
        lib.print.error(('login gagal: %s'):format(result))
        return false, 'Gagal memuat karakter'
    end

    if not result then return false, 'Gagal memuat karakter' end

    return true, 'Karakter dimuat'
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Hapus karakter
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:delete', function(source, citizenid)
    local license = getLicense(source)
    if not license then return false, 'Lisensi tidak terbaca' end

    local owner = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT license FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
    if not owner then return false, 'Karakter tidak ditemukan' end
    if owner ~= license then return false, 'Karakter bukan milik Anda' end

    local total = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE license = ?', { license }) or 0
    if total <= 1 then return false, 'Karakter terakhir tidak bisa dihapus' end

    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    if player and player.PlayerData.citizenid == citizenid then
        TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerUnload', source)
        QBCore.Players[source] = nil
    end

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM playerskins WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_partners WHERE citizenid = ? OR partner = ?', { citizenid, citizenid })
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? OR target = ?', { citizenid, citizenid })

    return true, 'Karakter dihapus'
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:spawn', function(source, id)
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    if not player then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end

    local position = player.PlayerData.position
    if not position or not position.x then position = locationById(id) end
    if not position or not position.x then position = DEFAULT_SPAWN end

    local heading = position.w or position.a or 0.0

    SetEntityCoords(source, position.x + 0.0, position.y + 0.0, position.z + 0.0, false, false, false, false)
    SetEntityHeading(source, heading)
    SetPlayerRoutingBucket(source, 0)

    return true
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_characters:server:spawned', function()
    local src = source
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end

    player.PlayerData.metadata.invBusy = false
    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData', src, player.PlayerData)
    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerSpawned', src)
end)

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Partner
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function myCitizen(source)
    local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    return player and player.PlayerData.citizenid or nil
end

local function partnerOf(citizenid)
    return MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT partner FROM character_partners WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid })
end

local function pushPartnerState(source)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return end

    local partner = partnerOf(citizenid)
    local payload = { partner = nil }

    if partner then
        local info = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT charinfo FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { partner })
        payload.partner = { citizenid = partner, name = fullName(decode(info)) }
    end

    local outgoing = MySQL.query.await('SELECT target AS citizenid FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ?', { citizenid }) or {}
    local incoming = MySQL.query.await('SELECT citizenid FROM character_invites WHERE target = ?', { citizenid }) or {}

    payload.outgoing = outgoing
    payload.incoming = incoming

    TriggerClientEvent('sm_characters:client:partnerSync', source, payload)
end

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:partner:invite', function(source, target)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end
    if type(target) ~= 'string' then return false, 'Target tidak valid' end
    if target == citizenid then return false, 'Tidak bisa mengundang diri sendiri' end

    if partnerOf(citizenid) then return false, 'Anda sudah punya partner' end
    if partnerOf(target) then return false, 'Target sudah punya partner' end

    local targetLicense = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT license FROM players WHERE citizenid = ?', { target })
    if not targetLicense then return false, 'Karakter target tidak ditemukan' end

    local targetSrc
    for src, player in pairs(QBCore.Players) do
        if player.PlayerData.citizenid == target then targetSrc = src break end
    end
    if not targetSrc then return false, 'Target sedang offline' end

    local exists = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT citizenid FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? AND target = ?', { citizenid, target })
    if exists then return false, 'Undangan sudah dikirim' end

    MySQL.insert.await('INSERT INTO character_invites (citizenid, target, expires) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',
        { citizenid, target, os.time() + INVITE_TTL })

    notify(targetSrc, 'Undangan partner masuk', 'inform')
    pushPartnerState(targetSrc)
    pushPartnerState(source)

    return true, 'Undangan dikirim'
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:partner:respond', function(source, inviter, accept)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end

    local expires = MySQL.scalar.await('SELECT expires FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? AND target = ?', { inviter, citizenid })
    if not expires then return false, 'Undangan tidak ditemukan' end

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? AND target = ?', { inviter, citizenid })

    if not accept then
        pushPartnerState(source)
        return true, 'Undangan ditolak'
    end

    if expires < os.time() then return false, 'Undangan kedaluwarsa' end
    if partnerOf(citizenid) or partnerOf(inviter) then return false, 'Salah satu sudah punya partner' end

    local now = os.time()
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_partners WHERE citizenid IN (?, ?)', { citizenid, inviter })
    MySQL.insert.await('INSERT INTO character_partners (citizenid, partner, since) VALUES (?, ?, ?), (?, ?, ?)',
        { citizenid, inviter, now, inviter, citizenid, now })

    local inviterSrc
    for src, player in pairs(QBCore.Players) do
        if player.PlayerData.citizenid == inviter then inviterSrc = src break end
    end

    if inviterSrc then
        notify(inviterSrc, 'Undangan partner diterima', 'success')
        pushPartnerState(inviterSrc)
    end

    pushPartnerState(source)
    return true, 'Undangan diterima'
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:partner:cancel', function(source, target)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid = ? AND target = ?', { citizenid, target })
    pushPartnerState(source)

    return true, 'Undangan dibatalkan'
end)

lib.callback.register('sm_characters:partner:remove', function(source, target)
    local citizenid = myCitizen(source)
    if not citizenid then return false, 'Karakter belum dimuat' end

    local partner = partnerOf(citizenid)
    if not partner then return false, 'Tidak ada partner' end
    if target and target ~= partner then return false, 'Bukan partner Anda' end

    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_partners WHERE citizenid IN (?, ?)', { citizenid, partner })
    MySQL.query.await('DELETE FROM character_invites WHERE citizenid IN (?, ?) OR target IN (?, ?)', { citizenid, partner, citizenid, partner })

    pushPartnerState(source)

    for src, player in pairs(QBCore.Players) do
        if player.PlayerData.citizenid == partner then
            notify(src, 'Partner Anda memutuskan hubungan', 'inform')
            pushPartnerState(src)
            break
        end
    end

    return true, 'Partner diputus'
end)

lib.print.info('sm_character server siap')

local Config = require "config.config"

local ipairs, pairs = ipairs, pairs
local GetGameTimer = GetGameTimer
local ceil = math.ceil

local Cooldowns = {}
local CooldownExpires = {}

for name, data in pairs(Config.Commands) do
    if data.cooldown and data.cooldown > 0 then
        Cooldowns[name] = data.cooldown * 1000
    end
end

---@param command string
---@return boolean
local function CheckCooldown(command)
    local duration = Cooldowns[command]
    if not duration then return true end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local expires = CooldownExpires[command]

    if expires and now < expires then
        lib.notify({
            title = 'Chat',
            description = ('Tunggu %d detik lagi untuk memakai /%s.'):format(ceil((expires - now) / 1000), command),
            type = 'error'
        })
        return false
    end

    CooldownExpires[command] = now + duration
    return true
end

local function BuildText(args)
    local text = ""
    for _, v in ipairs(args) do
        text = text .. " " .. v
    end
    return text
end

local function RegisterSimpleCommand(category, useMask)
    local command = Config.Commands[category].name

    RegisterCommand(command, function(source, args)
        local text = BuildText(args)
        if text:len() == 0 then return end
        if not CheckCooldown(command) then return end

        TriggerServerEvent('sm_chatheme:server:sendMessage', {
            category = category,
            message = text,
            isImage = false,
            mask = useMask and CheckMask() or false,
        })
    end, false)
end

exports('addMessage', function(message)
    while not ConfigLoaded do
        Wait(0)
    end

    TriggerServerEvent('sm_chatheme:server:sendMessage', {
        category = 'custom',
        message = message,
        isImage = false,
        mask = false,
    })
end)

########## FILE: \client\main.lua
local Config = require "config.config"
local DrawTextScale = Config.DefaultSettings.drawtextScale or 0.35

NuiLoaded = false
ConfigLoaded = false
WritingEffect = false
WritingPlayers = {}
ActiveSong = {}
RPTexts = {}
RPTextThread = false
ThreadType = 'native'
Dots = ""

local function GetWebLocales()
    local path = 'locales/' .. Config.Locale .. '.json'
    local file = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), path)

    if not file then
        file = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'locales/en.json')
    end

    if not file or file == '' then
        return {}
    end

    local success, content = pcall(json.decode, file)
    if not success or not content or not content['Web'] then
        return {}
    end

    return content['Web']
end

local function CheckNui()
    while not NuiLoaded do
        Wait(100)
    end
end

function SendVueMessage(action, payload)
    CheckNui()
    SendNUIMessage({
        action = action,
        payload = payload
    })
end

local function FetchNui()
    while not NuiLoaded do
        if NetworkIsSessionStarted() then
            SendNUIMessage({ action = "CHECK_NUI" })
        end
        Wait(2000)
    end

    SendVueMessage("SET_CONFIG", {
        Themes = Config.Themes,
        ThemeColors = Config.ThemeColors,
        MessageColors = Config.MessageColors,
        Categories = Config.Categories,
        QuickCommands = Config.QuickCommands,
        AllowedURLs = Config.ImageSettings.allowedURLs,
        Emojis = Config.Emojis,
        Locales = GetWebLocales(),
    })
end

function DrawDots(coords, text)
    local defaultScale = 0.65
    local camCoords = GetGameplayCamCoord()
    local dist = #(coords - camCoords)
    local scale = 200 / (GetGameplayCamFov() * dist)

    SetTextColour(255, 255, 255, 255)
    SetTextFont(0)
    SetTextScale(0.0, defaultScale * scale)
    SetTextDropshadow(0, 0, 0, 0, 55)
    SetTextDropShadow()
    SetTextCentre(true)

    BeginTextCommandDisplayText("STRING")
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(text)
    SetDrawOrigin(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, 0)
    EndTextCommandDisplayText(0.0, 0.0)
    ClearDrawOrigin()
end

function DrawText3D(x, y, z, text, color)
    local camCoords = GetGameplayCamCoord()
    local dist = #(vector3(x, y, z) - camCoords)
    local scale = 200 / (GetGameplayCamFov() * dist)

    SetTextColour(color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a)
    SetTextScale(0.0, DrawTextScale * scale)
    SetTextFont(4)
    SetTextDropshadow(0, 0, 0, 0, 55)
    SetTextDropShadow()
    SetTextCentre(true)

    BeginTextCommandDisplayText("STRING")
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(text)
    SetDrawOrigin(x, y, z, 0)
    EndTextCommandDisplayText(0.0, 0.0)
    ClearDrawOrigin()
end

function UpdateRPTexts(source, data)
    for k, v in ipairs(RPTexts) do
        if v.source == source then
            RPTexts[k] = data
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(RPTexts, data)
end

function CheckMask()
    if not Config.AnonymousWithMask then return false end

    local ped = cache.ped
    local pedModel = GetEntityModel(ped)

    if not Config.MaskIndexs[pedModel] then return false end

    local currentMaskIndex = GetPedDrawableVariation(ped, 1)

    if Config.AnyMask then
        return currentMaskIndex > 0
    end

    return Config.MaskIndexs[pedModel][tostring(currentMaskIndex)] == true
end

RegisterNetEvent('sm_chatheme:client:onPlayerLoaded', function()
    Wait(1500)
    FetchNui()
end)

RegisterNetEvent('onResourceStart', function(resourceName)
    if resourceName == GetCurrentResourceName() then
        Wait(1500)
        FetchNui()
    end
end)

RegisterKeyMapping("+chat", "Show chat", "KEYBOARD", Config.ShowChatKey or "T")
RegisterCommand("+chat", function()
    TriggerEvent("chat:show")
end, false)

AddEventHandler('sm_chatheme:client:playSound', function(name)
    if type(name) ~= 'string' or not name:match('^[%w_%-]+$') then return end

    SendVueMessage('PLAY_SOUND', { name = name })
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_chatheme:client:sendMessage', function(data)
    if not data then return end

    SendVueMessage('SEND_MESSAGE', data)

    local isRPCategory = data.category == 'do' or data.category == 'me' or data.category == 'dice' or data.category == 'rps'
    if not isRPCategory or data.isImage then return end

    UpdateRPTexts(data.source, data)

    if ThreadType == 'dui' then
        RPTextsDUIThread()
    else
        RPTexts3DThread()
    end

    Wait(5000)

    for k, v in ipairs(RPTexts) do
        if v.source == data.source and v.category == data.category and v.message == data.message then
            if ThreadType == 'dui' then
                SendVueMessage("REMOVE_3D_TEXT", { source = v.source })
            end
            table.remove(RPTexts, k)
            break
        end
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_chatheme:client:writingText', function(source, isWriting)
    if isWriting then
        WritingPlayers[tostring(source)] = true
        if not WritingEffect then
            FWritingEffect()
        end
    else
        WritingPlayers[tostring(source)] = nil
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('sm_chatheme:client:selfCommandSuggestion', function(command, help, params)
    TriggerEvent('chat:addSuggestion', command, help, params)

    SendVueMessage("ADD_CHAT_COMMAND_SUGGESTION", {
        command = string.gsub(command, "/", ""),
        description = help,
        params = params or {}
    })
end)

########## FILE: \client\nui.lua
local Config = require "config.config"

RegisterNUICallback('NUI_READY', function(_, cb)
    NuiLoaded = true
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback('CONFIG_READY', function(_, cb)
    ConfigLoaded = true
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback('CLOSE_UI', function(_, cb)
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("EXECUTE_COMMAND", function(command, cb)
    if not ConfigLoaded then return cb('ok') end
    Wait(200)
    ExecuteCommand(command)
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("TOGGLE_DICE", function(_, cb)
    ExecuteCommand('dice')
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("TOGGLE_RPS", function(_, cb)
    ExecuteCommand('rps')
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("TOGGLE_THREAD", function(data, cb)
    ThreadType = data.type
    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("SONG_PLAYING", function(data, cb)
    ActiveSong = {
        title = data.title or "Unknown Title",
        url = data.url or "",
        isPlaying = true,
        volume = Config.MusicSettings.defaultVolume,
    }

    if not ActiveSong.url or ActiveSong.url == "" then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    if GetResourceState("xsound") ~= "started" then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    exports.xsound:PlayUrl("sm_chatheme-song-" .. cache.serverId, ActiveSong.url, ActiveSong.volume, false)

    SendVueMessage("SONG_DATA", {
        title = ActiveSong.title,
        url = ActiveSong.url,
        isPlaying = true,
        volume = ActiveSong.volume,
    })

    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("TOGGLE_PLAYING", function(_, cb)
    if not ActiveSong or not ActiveSong.url then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    if GetResourceState('xsound') ~= 'started' then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    local xsound = exports.xsound
    local songId = "sm_chatheme-song-" .. cache.serverId

    if not xsound:soundExists(songId) then
        cb('ok')
        return
    end

    local isPaused = xsound:isPaused(songId)

    if isPaused then
        xsound:Resume(songId)
    else
        xsound:Pause(songId)
    end

    local newData = xsound:getInfo(songId)
    SendVueMessage("SONG_DATA", {
        title = ActiveSong.title,
        url = ActiveSong.url,
        isPlaying = isPaused,
        volume = newData.volume,
    })

    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("STOP_MUSIC", function(_, cb)
    if ActiveSong and ActiveSong.url and GetResourceState('xsound') == 'started' then
        local xsound = exports.xsound
        local songId = "sm_chatheme-song-" .. cache.serverId

        if xsound:soundExists(songId) then
            xsound:Destroy(songId)
            ActiveSong.isPlaying = false
        end
    end

    cb('ok')
end)

RegisterNUICallback("UPDATE_VOLUME", function(data, cb)
    if ActiveSong and ActiveSong.url and GetResourceState('xsound') == 'started' then
        local xsound = exports.xsound
        local songId = "sm_chatheme-song-" .. cache.serverId

        if xsound:soundExists(songId) then
            local volume = data.volume and tonumber(data.volume) / 100 or Config.MusicSettings.defaultVolume
            xsound:setVolume(songId, volume)
        end
    end

    cb('ok')
end)

########## FILE: \client\thread.lua
local Config = require "config.config"

local CreateThread = CreateThread
local Wait = Wait
local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
local GetPlayerPed = GetPlayerPed
local GetPlayerFromServerId = GetPlayerFromServerId
local GetHudScreenPositionFromWorldPosition = GetHudScreenPositionFromWorldPosition
local mathAbs = math.abs
local tonumber = tonumber
local next = next
local pairs = pairs

local MaxDistance = 10.0
local MoveThreshold = 0.05
local DefaultColor = { r = 255, g = 255, b = 255, a = 255 }
local DrawColors = Config.DefaultSettings.drawtextColors
local RemovePayload = {}

---@param text table
local function HideDUIText(text)
    if text.hidden then return end
    text.hidden = true
    text.oldScreenX = nil
    text.oldScreenY = nil
    RemovePayload.source = text.source
    SendVueMessage("REMOVE_3D_TEXT", RemovePayload)
end

function RPTextsDUIThread()
    if RPTextThread then return end
    RPTextThread = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while #RPTexts >= 1 do
            local playerPedCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

            for i = 1, #RPTexts do
                local text = RPTexts[i]
                local playerId = text.source and GetPlayerFromServerId(text.source) or -1

                if playerId == -1 then
                    HideDUIText(text)
                else
                    local targetPedCoords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(playerId))

                    if #(playerPedCoords - targetPedCoords) >= MaxDistance then
                        HideDUIText(text)
                    else
                        local offscreen, screenX, screenY = GetHudScreenPositionFromWorldPosition(
                            targetPedCoords.x, targetPedCoords.y, targetPedCoords.z + 1.0
                        )

                        if offscreen then
                            HideDUIText(text)
                        else
                            screenX = screenX * 100
                            screenY = screenY * 100
                            local oldX, oldY = text.oldScreenX, text.oldScreenY

                            if not oldX or mathAbs(oldX - screenX) > MoveThreshold or mathAbs(oldY - screenY) > MoveThreshold then
                                text.hidden = false
                                text.oldScreenX = screenX
                                text.oldScreenY = screenY
                                SendVueMessage('SHOW_3D_TEXT', {
                                    source = text.source,
                                    player = text.fullname,
                                    screenX = screenX,
                                    screenY = screenY,
                                    message = text.message,
                                    category = text.category,
                                    isDice = text.isDice,
                                    isRPS = text.isRPS,
                                    hand = text.hand or false,
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            Wait(0)
        end
        RPTextThread = false
    end)
end

function RPTexts3DThread()
    if RPText3DThread then return end
    RPText3DThread = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while #RPTexts >= 1 do
            local playerPedCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

            for i = 1, #RPTexts do
                local text = RPTexts[i]
                local playerId = text.source and GetPlayerFromServerId(text.source) or -1

                if playerId ~= -1 then
                    local targetPedCoords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(playerId))

                    if #(playerPedCoords - targetPedCoords) < MaxDistance then
                        DrawText3D(targetPedCoords.x, targetPedCoords.y, targetPedCoords.z, text.message, DrawColors[text.category] or DefaultColor)
                    end
                end
            end
            Wait(0)
        end
        RPText3DThread = false
    end)
end

function FWritingEffect()
    if WritingEffect then return end
    WritingEffect = true

    CreateThread(function()
        while next(WritingPlayers) ~= nil do
            local sleep = 500
            local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

            for source in pairs(WritingPlayers) do
                local writerId = GetPlayerFromServerId(tonumber(source))
                if writerId == -1 then
                    WritingPlayers[source] = nil
                else
                    local writerCoords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(writerId))
                    if #(playerCoords - writerCoords) <= 6.0 then
                        sleep = 0
                        DrawDots(vec3(writerCoords.x, writerCoords.y, writerCoords.z + 1.0), Dots)
                    end
                end
            end
            Wait(sleep)
        end
        WritingEffect = false
    end)
end

########## FILE: \modules\framework\es_extended\client.lua
---@diagnostic disable: duplicate-set-field
if GetResourceState('es_extended') ~= 'started' then return end

ESX = exports["es_extended"]:getSharedObject()

Framework = Framework or {}

Framework.GetFrameworkName = function()
    return 'es_extended'
end

---This will return a table of the players data, this is an internal table and should not be used.
---@return table
Framework.GetPlayerData = function()
    return ESX.GetPlayerData()
end

--<-- TODO swap to internal callback system
---This will return a table of all the jobs in the framework.
---@return table
Framework.GetFrameworkJobs = function()
    local jobs = lib.callback.await('sm_chatheme:callback:getFrameworkJobs', false)
    return jobs
end

---This will return the players birth date
---@return string
Framework.GetPlayerDob = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    local dob = playerData.dateofbirth
    return dob
end

---This will return the players metadata for the specified metadata key.
---@param metadata string
---@return table | nil
Framework.GetPlayerMetaData = function(metadata)
    return Framework.GetPlayerData().metadata[metadata]
end

---This will prompt the user with a notification message
---@param message string
---@param type string
---@param time number
---@return nil
Framework.Notify = function(message, type, time)
    return ESX.ShowNotification(message, type, time)
end

---Will Display the help text message on the screen
---@param message string
---@param _ unknown
---@return nil
Framework.ShowHelpText = function(message, _)
    return exports['esx_textui']:TextUI(message, "info")
end

---This will hide the help text message on the screen
---@return nil
Framework.HideHelpText = function()
    return exports['esx_textui']:HideUI()
end

---This will return the players identifier
---@return string
Framework.GetPlayerIdentifier = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.identifier
end

---This will return the players first name, and the last name
---@return string
---@return string
Framework.GetPlayerName = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.firstName, playerData.lastName
end

---This will return the players job name, job label, job grade label and job grade level
---@return string
---@return string
---@return string
---@return string
Framework.GetPlayerJob = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.job.name, playerData.job.label, playerData.job.grade_label, playerData.job.grade
end

---This will return a boolean if the player has the item in their inventory
---@param item string
---@return boolean
Framework.HasItem = function(item)
	local hasItem = ESX.SearchInventory(item, true)
	return hasItem > 0 and true or false
end

---This will return a table of the players inventory
---@return table
Framework.GetPlayerInventory = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.inventory
end

---This will return a number of the item in the players inventory
---@param item string
---@return number
Framework.GetItemCount = function(item)
    local inventory = Framework.GetPlayerInventory()
    if not inventory then return 0 end
    return inventory[item].count or 0
end

---This will return a boolean if the player is dead
---@return boolean
Framework.GetIsPlayerDead = function()
    local playerData = Framework.GetPlayerData()
    return playerData.dead
end

    local frameworkInv = QBPlayerData.items
    if not frameworkInv then return 0 end
    local count = 0

        end

    return count

########## FILE: \utils\locales.lua
local Config = require 'config.config'

local function LoadLocaleFile()
    local path = 'locales/' .. Config.Locale .. '.json'
    local file = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), path)

    if not file then
        file = LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'locales/en.json')
        print(('Locale file "%s" not found, falling back to default "en".'):format(Config.Locale))
    end

    return file
end

local function LoadLocale()
    local file = LoadLocaleFile()

	if not file or file == '' then
        error('Locale file is empty or not found')
    end

    local success, content = pcall(json.decode, file)

	if not success then
        error(('Failed to decode JSON from locale file: %s'):format(content))
    end


    if not content['Lua'] then
        error('Missing "Lua" section in locale file')
    end

    return content['Lua']
end

Locales = LoadLocale()

function _T(key, ...)
    if Locales[key] then
        return Locales[key]:format(...)
    end
    return key
end

local function getCore(filters)
    if not filters then return QBCore end

    local results = {}
    for i = 1, #filters do
        local key = filters[i]
        if QBCore[key] then
            results[key] = QBCore[key]
        end
    end

    return results
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPlayerLoaded', function()
    ShutdownLoadingScreenNui()
    if not QBConfig.Server.PVP then return end
    SetCanAttackFriendly(PlayerPedId(), true, false)
    NetworkSetFriendlyFireOption(true)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:PvpHasToggled', function(pvp_state)
    SetCanAttackFriendly(PlayerPedId(), pvp_state, false)
    NetworkSetFriendlyFireOption(pvp_state)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('qb_event_client:tptocoords', function(coords)
    if source == '' then return end

    local x, y, z, h = table.unpack(coords)
    if not h then h = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped) end
    SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(cache.ped, x, y, z)
    SetEntityHeading(cache.ped, h)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('qb_event_client:gotoMarker', function()
    if source == '' then return end

    local GetEntityCoords = GetEntityCoords
    local GetGroundZFor_3dCoord = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord

    local blipMarker <const> = GetFirstBlipInfoId(8)

    if not DoesBlipExist(blipMarker) then
        QBCore.Functions.Notify(Lang:t('error.no_waypoint'), 'error', 5000)
        return
    end

    -- Fade screen to hide how clients get teleported.
    DoScreenFadeOut(650)
    while not IsScreenFadedOut() do
        Wait(0)
    end

    local ped, coords <const> = cache.ped, GetBlipInfoIdCoord(blipMarker)
    local vehicle = GetVehiclePedIsIn(ped, false)
    local oldCoords <const> = GetEntityCoords(ped)

    -- Unpack coords instead of having to unpack them while iterating.
    -- 825.0 seems to be the max a player can reach while 0.0 being the lowest.
    local x, y, groundZ, Z_START = coords['x'], coords['y'], 850.0, 950.0
    local found = false
    if vehicle > 0 then
        FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, true)
    else
        FreezeEntityPosition(ped, true)
    end

    for i = Z_START, 0, -25.0 do
        local z = i
        if (i % 2) ~= 0 then
            z = Z_START - i
        end

        NewLoadSceneStart(x, y, z, x, y, z, 50.0, 0)
        local curTime = GetGameTimer()
        while IsNetworkLoadingScene() do
            if GetGameTimer() - curTime > 1000 then
                break
            end
            Wait(0)
        end
        NewLoadSceneStop()
        SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(ped, x, y, z)

        while not HasCollisionLoadedAroundEntity(ped) do
            RequestCollisionAtCoord(x, y, z)
            if GetGameTimer() - curTime > 1000 then
                break
            end
            Wait(0)
        end

        -- Get ground coord. As mentioned in the natives, this only works if the client is in render distance.
        found, groundZ = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(x, y, z, false);
        if found then
            Wait(0)
            SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(ped, x, y, groundZ)
            break
        end
        Wait(0)
    end

    -- Remove black screen once the loop has ended.
    DoScreenFadeIn(650)
    if vehicle > 0 then
        FreezeEntityPosition(vehicle, false)
    else
        FreezeEntityPosition(ped, false)
    end

    if not found then
        -- If we can't find the coords, set the coords to the old ones.
        -- We don't unpack them before since they aren't in a loop and only called once.
        SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(ped, oldCoords['x'], oldCoords['y'], oldCoords['z'] - 1.0)
        QBCore.Functions.Notify(Lang:t('error.tp_error'), 'error', 5000)
    end

    -- If Z coord was found, set coords in found coords.
    SetPedCoordsKeepVehicle(ped, x, y, groundZ)
    QBCore.Functions.Notify(Lang:t('success.teleported_waypoint'), 'success', 5000)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('qb_event_client:spawnVehicle', function(vehName, serverPlate)
    if source == '' then return end

    local ok, hash = pcall(function ()
        return lib.requestModel(vehName)
    end)

    if not ok then
        if hash then
            lib.print.warn(hash)
        end
        return
    end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(cache.ped)
    local vehicle = QBCore.Functions.SpawnVehicle(hash, nil, vec(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading), true, true)

    if not (vehicle and DoesEntityExist(vehicle)) then
        return
    end

    SetEntityHeading(vehicle, heading)
    local plate = serverPlate or ('SM ' .. lib.string.random('.....'))
    SetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle, plate)
    TriggerEvent('sm_vehiclekeys:client:setVehicleOwner', plate)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('qb_event_client:deleteVehicle', function()
    if source == '' then return end

    local coords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    
    if cache.vehicle then
        SetEntityAsMissionEntity(cache.vehicle, true, true)
        DeleteEntity(cache.vehicle)
        return
    end

    local vehicle = lib.getClosestVehicle(coords, 3.0)
    if not vehicle then
        return
    end

    SetEntityAsMissionEntity(vehicle, true, true)
    DeleteEntity(vehicle)
end)

local eventHooks = require 'modules.hooks'

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Player:setPData', function(key, val, subVal)
    if source == '' then return end

    if key == 'all' then
        QBCore.PlayerData = val
        goto skip
    end

    if not QBCore.PlayerData[key] then
        QBCore.PlayerData[key] = (subVal ~= nil) and {} or val
    end

    if subVal ~= nil then
        if type(QBCore.PlayerData[key]) ~= 'table' then
            QBCore.PlayerData[key] = {}
        end
        QBCore.PlayerData[key][val] = subVal
    else
        QBCore.PlayerData[key] = val
    end

    ::skip::

    TriggerEvent('QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData', QBCore.PlayerData)
    eventHooks('core:updatePlayerData', QBCore.PlayerData)
    eventHooks('core:updatePlayerDataBykey', key, val, subVal)
end)

local blockedWords = {
    'crytxontop', 'crytx', 'hama kontol', 'dev magang',
    'discord.gg', 'p5uquhsukq',
    'ngentot', 'lonte', 'goblok', 'kontol', 'tolol', 'tonggos',
}

local function containsBlocked(text)
    if not text then return false end
    local lower = string.lower(tostring(text))
    for _, word in ipairs(blockedWords) do
        if string.find(lower, word, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Notify', function(text, type, length, icon)
    if containsBlocked(text) then return end
    QBCore.Functions.Notify(text, type, length, icon)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('getNotifyConfig', function(_, cb)
    cb(QBConfig.Notify)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('rhd_spawn:client:onSpawn', function(data)
    local metadata = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata

    local health = metadata.health
    local armour = metadata.armor

    Wait(1500)
    if health and type(health) == "number" then
        SetEntityMaxHealth(cache.ped, 200)
        SetEntityHealth(cache.ped, health)
    end

    if armour and type(armour) == "number" then
        SetPedArmour(cache.ped, armour)
    end
end)


---@SpawnVehicle

-- Set vehicle props
---@param netId number
---@param props table<any, any>
RegisterNetEvent('sm_core:client:setVehicleProperties', function(netId, props)
    if not props then return end
    local timeOut = GetGameTimer() + 1000
    local vehicle = NetworkGetEntityFromNetworkId(netId)
    while true do
        if NetworkGetEntityOwner(vehicle) == cache.playerId then
            if lib.setVehicleProperties(vehicle, props) then
                return
            end
        end
        if GetGameTimer() > timeOut then
            return
        end

        Wait(50)
    end
end)

-- Clear vehicle peds
---@param vehicle number
---@param init boolean
qbLib.entityStateHandler('initVehicle', function(vehicle, _, init)
    if not init then return end

    for i = -1, 0 do
        local ped = GetPedInVehicleSeat(vehicle, i)
        if ped ~= cache.ped and ped > 0 and NetworkGetEntityOwner(ped) == cache.playerId then
            DeleteEntity(ped)
        end
    end

    lib.waitFor(function()
        return not IsEntityWaitingForWorldCollision(vehicle)
    end)

    if NetworkGetEntityOwner(vehicle) ~= cache.playerId then return end

    local state = Entity(vehicle).state

    SetVehicleOnGroundProperly(vehicle);

    SetTimeout(0, function()
        state:set('initVehicle', nil, true)
    end)
end)

########## FILE: \client\loops.lua
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local pstate = LocalPlayer.state
        if pstate.isLoggedIn then
            local hunger = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata['hunger']
            local thirst = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata['thirst']
            local isDead = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata['isdead']
            local inLastStand = QBCore.PlayerData.metadata['inlaststand']
            
            if not pstate.inGhostHunting and hunger and thirst and (hunger <= 0 or thirst <= 0) and not (isDead or inLastStand) then
                local ped = PlayerPedId()
                local currentHealth = GetEntityHealth(ped)
                local decreaseThreshold = math.random(5, 10)
                SetEntityHealth(ped, currentHealth - decreaseThreshold)
            end
        end
        Wait(QBCore.Config.StatusInterval)
    end
end)

local qbExport = require 'export-functions'

local qbFn = setmetatable({}, {
    __newindex = function (self, key, fn)
        rawset(self, key, fn)

        if type(fn) == "function" then
            exports(key, fn)
            qbExport(key, fn)
        end
    end
})

local isServer = lib.context == 'server'

---@param pool string
---@param ignoreList? integer[]
---@return integer[]
local function getEntities(pool, ignoreList) -- luacheck: ignore
    ignoreList = ignoreList or {}
    local ents = GetGamePool(pool)
    local entities = {}
    local ignoreMap = {}
    for i = 1, #ignoreList do
        ignoreMap[ignoreList[i]] = true
    end

    for i = 1, #ents do
        local entity = ents[i]
        if not ignoreMap[entity] then
            entities[#entities + 1] = entity
        end
    end
    return entities
end

---@param entities integer[]
---@param coords vector3? if unset uses player coords
---@return integer closestObj or -1
---@return number closestDistance or -1
local function getClosestEntity(entities, coords) -- luacheck: ignore
    coords = type(coords) == 'table' and vec3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z) or coords or GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
    local closestDistance = -1
    local closestEntity = -1
    for i = 1, #entities do
        local entity = entities[i]
        local entityCoords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
        local distance = #(entityCoords - coords)
        if closestDistance == -1 or closestDistance > distance then
            closestEntity = entity
            closestDistance = distance
        end
    end
    return closestEntity, closestDistance
end

---@param entity number
---@return vector4
function qbFn.GetCoords(entity)
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity, false)
    local heading = GetEntityHeading(entity)
    return vector4(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading)
end

    ---@param bucket number

        local curr_bucket_pool = {}
        if not (QBCore.Player_Buckets or next(QBCore.Player_Buckets)) then
            return false
        end

        for k, v in pairs(QBCore.Player_Buckets) do
            if v == bucket then
                curr_bucket_pool[#curr_bucket_pool + 1] = k
            end
        end

        return curr_bucket_pool
    end

            end
        end

    ---@param source any
    ---@param model any
    ---@param coords vector4
    ---@param warp boolean
    ---@return number
    function qbFn.CreateAutomobile(source, model, coords, warp)
        model = type(model) == 'string' and joaat(model) or model

        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: cast-local-type
        if not coords then coords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(source)) end
        local heading = coords.w and coords.w or 0.0
        local CreateAutomobileNative = `CREATE_AUTOMOBILE`

        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: param-type-mismatch
        local veh = Citizen.InvokeNative(CreateAutomobileNative, model, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, heading, true, true)
        while not DoesEntityExist(veh) do Wait(0) end
        if warp then TaskWarpPedIntoVehicle(GetPlayerPed(source), veh, -1) end
        return veh
    end

    qbFn.Kick = function(source, reason, setKickReason, deferrals)
        reason = ('\n %s \n Ã°Å¸â€Â¸ Check our Discord for further information: %s'):format(reason, QBConfig.Server.Discord)
        if setKickReason then

        CreateThread(function()
            if deferrals then
                deferrals.update(reason)
                Wait(2500)
            end
            if source then
                DropPlayer(source --[[@as string]], reason)

            for _ = 0, 4 do
                while true do

                        if GetPlayerPing(source --[[@as string]]) >= 0 then
                            break
                        end
                        Wait(100)
                        CreateThread(function()
                            DropPlayer(source --[[@as string]], reason)
                        end)
                    end
                end
                Wait(5000)
            end
        end)

    ---@deprecated use cfg ACEs instead
    ---@param source Source
    ---@param permission string
    function qbFn.AddPermission(source, permission)
        if not IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], permission) then
            lib.addPrincipal('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. permission)
            lib.addAce('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. permission)
            TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
            TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
        end
    end

    ---@deprecated use cfg ACEs instead
    ---@param source Source
    ---@param permission string
    function qbFn.RemovePermission(source, permission)
        if permission then
            if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], permission) then
                lib.removePrincipal('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. permission)
                lib.removeAce('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. permission)
                TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
                TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
            end
        else
            local hasUpdated = false

            ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: deprecated
            for _, v in pairs(QBConfig.Server.Permissions) do
                if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], v) then
                    lib.removePrincipal('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. v)
                    lib.removeAce('player.' .. source, 'group.' .. v)
                    hasUpdated = true
                end
            end
            if hasUpdated then
                TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
                TriggerEvent('QBCore:Server:OnPermissionUpdate', source)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Checking for Permission Level
    ---@deprecated use IsPlayerAceAllowed
    ---@param source Source
    ---@param permission string|string[]
    ---@return boolean
    function qbFn.HasPermission(source, permission)
        if type(permission) == 'string' then
            if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], permission) then return true end
        elseif type(permission) == 'table' then
            for _, permLevel in pairs(permission) do
                if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], permLevel) then return true end
            end
        end

        return false
    end

        local perms = {}

        ---@diagnostic disable-next-line: deprecated
        for _, v in pairs (QBConfig.Server.Permissions) do
            if IsPlayerAceAllowed(source --[[@as string]], v) then
                perms[v] = true
            end
        end
        return perms
    end

    ---@deprecated use the GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone native and calculate distance directly
    qbFn.GetClosestBone = function(entity, list)
        local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)

        ---@type integer | {id: integer} | {id: integer, type: string, name: string}, vector3, number
        local bone, coords, distance
        for _, element in pairs(list) do
            local boneCoords = GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(entity, element.id or element)
            local boneDistance = #(playerCoords - boneCoords)
            if not coords or distance > boneDistance then
                bone = element
                coords = boneCoords
                distance = boneDistance
            end
        end
        if not bone then
            bone = {id = GetEntityBoneIndexByName(entity, 'bodyshell'), type = 'remains', name = 'bodyshell'}
            coords = GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(entity, bone.id)
            distance = #(coords - playerCoords)
        end
        return bone, coords, distance
    end

    ---@deprecated use the GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone native and calculate distance directly
    qbFn.GetBoneDistance = function(entity, boneType, bone)
        local boneIndex = boneType == 1 and GetPedBoneIndex(entity, bone --[[@as integer]]) or GetEntityBoneIndexByName(entity, bone --[[@as string]])
        local boneCoords = GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(entity, boneIndex)
        local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
        return #(playerCoords - boneCoords)
    end

    ---@deprecated use the AttachEntityToEntity native directly
    qbFn.AttachProp = function(ped, model, boneId, x, y, z, xR, yR, zR, vertex)
        local modelHash = type(model) == 'string' and joaat(model) or model
        local bone = GetPedBoneIndex(ped, boneId)
        lib.requestModel(modelHash)
        local prop = CreateObject(modelHash, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, true, true, false)
        AttachEntityToEntity(prop, ped, bone, x, y, z, xR, yR, zR, true, true, false, true, not vertex and 2 or 0, true)
        SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(modelHash)
        return prop
    end

    ---@deprecated use lib.getNearbyVehicles from ox_lib
    qbFn.SpawnClear = function(coords, radius)
        coords = type(coords) == 'table' and vec3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z) or coords or GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
        radius = radius or 5
        local vehicles = GetGamePool('CVehicle')
        local closeVeh = {}
        for i = 1, #vehicles do
            local vehicleCoords = GetEntityCoords(vehicles[i])
            local distance = #(vehicleCoords - coords)
            if distance <= radius then
                closeVeh[#closeVeh + 1] = vehicles[i]
            end
        end
        return #closeVeh == 0
    end

    ---@deprecated use lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset from ox_lib
    qbFn.LoadParticleDictionary = lib.requestNamedPtfxAsset

    qbFn.StartParticleAtCoord = require 'lib.particle.client'.StartParticleAtCoord
    qbFn.StartParticleOnEntity = require 'lib.particle.client'.StartParticleOnEntity

    ---@param coords vector3
    ---@return table
    function qbFn.GetStreetNametAtCoords(coords)
        local streetname1, streetname2 = GetStreetNameAtCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)
        return { main = GetStreetNameFromHashKey(streetname1), cross = GetStreetNameFromHashKey(streetname2) }
    end

    qbFn.GetZoneAtCoords = qbLib.getZoneName

    qbFn.GetCardinalDirection = qbLib.getCardinalDirection

    ---@deprecated use the GetClockMinutes and GetClockHours natives and format the output directly
    qbFn.GetCurrentTime = function()
        local obj = {}
        obj.min = GetClockMinutes()
        obj.hour = GetClockHours()

        if obj.hour <= 12 then
            obj.ampm = 'AM'
        elseif obj.hour >= 13 then
            obj.ampm = 'PM'
            obj.formattedHour = obj.hour - 12
        end

        if obj.min <= 9 then
            obj.formattedMin = ('0%s'):format(obj.min)
        end

        return obj
    end

    ---@deprecated use the GetGroundZFor_3dCoord native directly
    qbFn.GetGroundZCoord = function(coords)
        if not coords then return end

        local retval, groundZ = GetGroundZFor_3dCoord(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z, false)
        if retval then
            return vec3(coords.x, coords.y, groundZ)
        end

        lib.print.verbose('Couldn\'t find Ground Z Coordinates given 3D Coordinates:', coords)
        return coords
    end

    ---@param entity number
    ---@return number, number, vector3, vector3, boolean, number
    function qbFn.GetGroundHash(entity)
        local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
        local num = StartShapeTestCapsule(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 4, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z - 2.0, 1, 1, entity, 7)
        local retval, success, endCoords, surfaceNormal, materialHash, entityHit = GetShapeTestResultEx(num)
        return materialHash, entityHit, surfaceNormal, endCoords, success, retval
    end
end

QBCore.Functions = qbFn

########## FILE: \lib\callback\client.lua
local pendingServerCbs = {}
local clientRateLimit   = {}

local RATE_LIMIT_MAX    = 10   -- max calls per window
local RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 5000 -- ms
local CB_TIMEOUT        = 15000 -- ms

local cbCounter = 0
local function makeId()
    cbCounter += 1
    return ('%d-%d-%d'):format(cache.serverId, GetGameTimer(), cbCounter)
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(30000)
        local now = GetGameTimer()

        for id, entry in pairs(pendingServerCbs) do
            if now > entry.expires then
                lib.print.verbose(('[cb:client] timeout: %s'):format(entry.name))
                pendingServerCbs[id] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end)

---@param name string
---@return boolean allowed
local function checkRateLimit(name)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local entry = clientRateLimit[name]

    if not entry or now > entry.resetAt then
        clientRateLimit[name] = { count = 1, resetAt = now + RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW }
        return true
    end

    entry.count += 1

    if entry.count > RATE_LIMIT_MAX then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:client] rate limit exceeded: %s'):format(name))
        return false
    end

    return true
end

---@param name string Callback name
---@param cb function Handler: function(cb, ...)
local function CreateClientCallback(name, cb)
    QBCore.ClientCallbacks[name] = cb
end

---@param name string Callback name
---@param ... any Optional leading cb function, then args to server
---@return any # Returns server result when no cb provided (async)
local function TriggerCallback(name, ...)
    if not checkRateLimit(name) then return end

    local cb = nil
    local args = { ... }

    if QBCore.Shared.IsFunction(args[1]) then
        cb = args[1]
        table.remove(args, 1)
    end

    local cbId = makeId()
    local p = promise.new()

    pendingServerCbs[cbId] = {
        name     = name,
        promise  = p,
        callback = cb,
        expires  = GetGameTimer() + CB_TIMEOUT,
    }

    TriggerServerEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerCallback', name, cbId, table.unpack(args))

    if cb == nil then
        Citizen.Await(p)
        return p.value
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerClientCallback', function(name, cbId, ...)
    if source == '' then return end

    if not QBCore.ClientCallbacks[name] then return end

    QBCore.ClientCallbacks[name](function(...)
        TriggerServerEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerClientCallback', cbId, ...)
    end, ...)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerCallback', function(name, cbId, ...)
    if source == '' then return end

    local entry = pendingServerCbs[cbId]
    if not entry then return end

    if entry.name ~= name then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:client] name mismatch: got %s expected %s'):format(name, entry.name))
        return
    end

    if GetGameTimer() > entry.expires then
        pendingServerCbs[cbId] = nil
        return
    end

    pendingServerCbs[cbId] = nil

    entry.promise:resolve(...)

    if entry.callback then
        entry.callback(...)
    end
end)

return {
    CreateClientCallback = CreateClientCallback,
    TriggerCallback      = TriggerCallback,
}


########## FILE: \lib\callback\server.lua
local pendingClientCbs = {}
local serverCbRateLimit = {}

local RATE_LIMIT_MAX    = 10   -- max calls per window
local RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 5000 -- ms
local CB_TIMEOUT        = 120000 -- ms sebelum entry dianggap expired

local cbCounter = 0
local function makeId(source)
    cbCounter += 1
    return ('%d-%d-%d'):format(source, GetGameTimer(), cbCounter)
end

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(30000)
        local now = GetGameTimer()

        for id, entry in pairs(pendingClientCbs) do
            if now > entry.expires then
                lib.print.verbose(('[cb:server] timeout: %s | src: %s'):format(entry.name, entry.source))
                pendingClientCbs[id] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local src = source
    serverCbRateLimit[src] = nil

    for id, entry in pairs(pendingClientCbs) do
        if entry.source == src then
            pendingClientCbs[id] = nil
        end
    end
end)

---@param src number
---@param name string
---@return boolean allowed
local function checkRateLimit(src, name)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    serverCbRateLimit[src] = serverCbRateLimit[src] or {}
    local entry = serverCbRateLimit[src][name]

    if not entry or now > entry.resetAt then
        serverCbRateLimit[src][name] = { count = 1, resetAt = now + RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW }
        return true
    end

    entry.count += 1
    if entry.count > RATE_LIMIT_MAX then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:server] rate limit exceeded: %s | src: %s'):format(name, src))
        return false
    end

    return true
end

---@param name string Callback name
---@param source number Player server ID
---@param ... any Additional args passed to client (optional leading cb function)
---@return any # Returns callback result when no cb provided (async)
local function TriggerClientCallback(name, source, ...)
    local cb = nil
    local args = { ... }

    if QBCore.Shared.IsFunction(args[1]) then
        cb = args[1]
        table.remove(args, 1)
    end

    local cbId = makeId(source)
    local p = promise.new()

    pendingClientCbs[cbId] = {
        source   = source,
        name     = name,
        promise  = p,
        callback = cb,
        expires  = GetGameTimer() + CB_TIMEOUT,
    }

    TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerClientCallback', source, name, cbId, table.unpack(args))

    if cb == nil then
        Citizen.Await(p)
        return p.value
    end
end

---@param name string Callback name
---@param cb function Handler: function(source, cb, ...)
local function CreateCallback(name, cb)
    QBCore.ServerCallbacks[name] = cb
end

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerClientCallback', function(cbId, ...)
    local source = source
    local entry = pendingClientCbs[cbId]

    if not entry then return end
    if entry.source ~= source then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:server] cbId mismatch src %s != expected %s | id: %s'):format(source))
        return
    end

    if GetGameTimer() > entry.expires then
        pendingClientCbs[cbId] = nil
        return
    end

    pendingClientCbs[cbId] = nil

    entry.promise:resolve(...)

    if entry.callback then
        entry.callback(...)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('QBCore:Server:TriggerCallback', function(name, cbId, ...)
    local src = source

    if not QBCore.ServerCallbacks[name] then
        lib.print.warn(('[cb:server] callback not found: %s | src: %s'):format(name, src))
        return
    end

    if not checkRateLimit(src, name) then return end

    QBCore.ServerCallbacks[name](src, function(...)
        TriggerClientEvent('QBCore:Client:TriggerCallback', src, name, cbId, ...)
    end, ...)
end)

return {
    TriggerClientCallback = TriggerClientCallback,
    CreateCallback        = CreateCallback,
}

local functions = {}

---@deprecated use lib.progressBar from ox_lib
---@param label string
---@param duration integer ms
---@param useWhileDead boolean
---@param canCancel boolean
---@param disableControls? {disableMovement: boolean, disableCarMovement: boolean, disableCombat: boolean, disableMouse: boolean}
---@param animation? {animDict: string, anim: string, flags: unknown}
---@param prop? unknown
---@param onFinish fun()
---@param onCancel fun()
function functions.Progressbar(_, label, duration, useWhileDead, canCancel, disableControls, animation, prop, _, onFinish, onCancel)
    if lib.progressBar({
        duration = duration,
        label = label,
        useWhileDead = useWhileDead,
        canCancel = canCancel,
        disable = {
            move = disableControls?.disableMovement,
            car = disableControls?.disableCarMovement,
            combat = disableControls?.disableCombat,
            mouse = disableControls?.disableMouse,
        },
        anim = {
            dict = animation?.animDict,
            clip = animation?.anim,
            flags = animation?.flags
        },
        prop = {
            model = prop?.model,
            pos = prop?.coords,
            rot = prop?.rotation,
        },
    }) then
        if onFinish then
            onFinish()
        end
    else
        if onCancel then
            onCancel()
        end
    end
end

---Text box popup for player which dissappears after a set time.
---@param text table|string text of the notification
---@param notifyType? NotificationType informs default styling. Defaults to 'inform'
---@param duration? integer milliseconds notification will remain on screen. Defaults to 5000
---@param subTitle? string extra text under the title
---@param notifyPosition? NotificationPosition
---@param notifyStyle? table Custom styling. Please refer too https://coxdocs.dev/ox_lib/Modules/Interface/Client/notify#libnotify
---@param notifyIcon? string Font Awesome 6 icon name
---@param notifyIconColor? string Custom color for the icon chosen before
function functions.Notify(text, notifyType, duration, subTitle, notifyPosition, notifyStyle, notifyIcon, notifyIconColor)
    local title, description
    if type(text) == 'table' then
        title = text.text or 'Placeholder'
        description = text.caption or nil
    elseif subTitle then
        title = text
        description = subTitle
    else
        description = text
    end

    local position = notifyPosition or 'top-right'

    lib.notify({
        id = title,
        title = title,
        description = description,
        duration = duration,
        type = notifyType,
        position = position,
        style = notifyStyle,
        icon = notifyIcon,
        iconColor = notifyIconColor
    })
end

return functions
